śrī-Śāntināthāya namaḥ ||

śrīmat-parama-gambhīra-syād-vādāmōgha-lāñchhanam |
jiyat trailōkya-nāthasya śāsanam Jina-śāsanam ||
vara-Vṛṣabhu-tīrtthakara Gaṇa- |
dhara-vaṃśa-sambhavāchā- |
ryyara pempam pogalaḷ aṛidapane Phaṇiramaṇam ||
ā-niyamāgraṇigaḷu Jina- |
sēna-śrī-Virasēnar enip āchāryyar |
bhū-nuta-charitrar avaram |
jānisuva vinēya-janada permmey ad ammam ||
amarda tad-anvayadim ban- |
da munīśaru Lakṣmiśēna-bhaṭṭārakar ut- |
tama-charitar avara śishyar |
vimala-guṇaru Candrasēna-sūrigal anaghar ||
ā-muni-rājara śishyō- |
ddāmaru Munibhadra-Dēvar avara charitram |
bhū-mahitam endoḍ adan inn |
ē-matō bannisalre ballavan āvam ||

vṛ || kṣēṇam amarvvinam vimala-kīrtti dig-antaman eyd aḍarvvinam |
Kāmana chāpa chāpaḷate sārvvinam oppidaram pogaḷdapem |
śrī-Munibhadra-Dēvaran iḷā-vinutōru-śubha-svabhāvaram |
prēmadoḷ arttig artthamuman ivaran ugra-tapaḥ-prabhāvaram ||
munisam Manmatha-yuddhadoḷ nirutamoḷ tatvārttthadoḷ bhaktiyam |
Jina-pādāmbujadoḷ dravādhikateyam sach-chittaḍoḷ dēseyam |
vinutāchāra-chayaṅgaḷoḷ vachanamam vaktritvadoḷ rukma-rañ- |
janeyam dēhada kāntiyoḷ ṇirisidar vākyādi-varṇṇahvayar ||

kaṃ || Hisugaḷla basadiyam mā- |
ḍisi Muḷugundada Jinēndra-mandirake sudhā- |
prasaramam esagisi jasamam |
pasarisi Munibhadra-Dēvar olpam taḷedar ||
nyāyōpāyada Harihara- |
Rāyam vara-Vijayanagariyoḷu nelasirppaḍ |
āyatikeya Sēna-gaṇa- |
jyāyaru Munibhadra-Dēvar aran eṛakadavar ||

50 Sorab Taluq.

int eseva tapaś-caraṇâ- |
nantaram āptāgama-prabhāvaman esagut- |
taṃ tūḷdi duritamam niś- |
chintaru Munibhadra-Dēvar irppanevaram ||
kālāvasāna-samsthitig |
ālambam enippa nirṇayam dorakaḷoḍam |
śilāchāra-samāja-vi- |
śālar Munibhadra-Dēvar-aṛitam janisal ||
nir-oḷagaṇa-tāvarey-ele |
niram poradante bāhya-vastuvan ellam |
dūram māḍi baḷḷikkam |
dhīraru Munibhadra-Dēvar agaṇita-mahimar ||
vṛi || kṣhame niśśalyam enutte sanyasanadind ātma-prabōdhōdayam |
samasand ondire dibya-pañcha-pada-chintā-paṅkti munt eyduv ut- |
tama-tāpakk adu sañchitārttam ene dharma-dhyāna-maunōdyama- |
kramdindam Munibhadra-Dēvar oḍalim bēr-mmāḍidar jjīvamam ||
lasita-S’akāṅkam udgha-nabha-chandra-purēnduvininde sōbhisal |
pesarvaḍed oppi tōrppa vilasad-Vibhavābda-dada Chaitra-suddha-tē- |
rase-S’anivāraḍoḷ sakaḷa-sanyasana-byasanam samādhi san- |
dise Manibhadra-Dēvar uṛe saḍ-gati-saukhyaman eḍidar nnijam ||
ka || lasita-Munibhadra-Dēvara |
nisidhiyuman avara śishyar ene sogayipa Pāvi- |
sasēna-Dēvar uṛe mā- |
ḍisi kīrttiyan antar intu Kantu-vidūrar ||
bhadram astu Jina-śāsanam śrī

svasti samasta-bhuvanāśrayam śrī-prithvi-vallabham mahārājādhirājam paramēśvaram parama-
bhaṭṭārakam Satyāśraya-kula-tilakam Chāḷukyābharaṇam śrīmaj-Jayasimha-Dēvam prithvi-rājyam
geyye S’aka-nṛipa-kāḷātīta-samvastara-śataṅgaḷ *obaynūr-ayvattombattaney Aṅgīrasa-samvatsarada
Paushyada puṇṇame-Vaḍḍavāraḍ-uttarāyaṇa-saṅkrāntyandu samadhigata-pañcha-mahā-śabda
mahā-sāmantādhipati Trikunda-pura-varēśvara Brahma-Kshatriyam Māṭūra-vamśōdbhavam Naudana-
vana-chhatra . . . vatāra haya-lāñchhehhanam darppaṇa-dhvaja-virājamāna para-sainya-Bhairavam
ripu-baḷa-mallam samaraika-dhīram nuḍiṭe gaṇḍam parākrama-siṅgam toḷagadam gaṇḍam
śauryyagāram śrīmad-Āḷayyam Banavāsi-pannirchhehhasīram Sāntalige-sāsiramum ēka-cheh-
hatra-chhēyeyin āḷuttam iḍu maṇḍalikam Kundamaṇgē Kuppagaḍḍeya bayalam kaḷam bandu ‖
vṛitta ‖ baḷavad-arāti-sēne kiḍe vāji-baḷam perapiṅge hasti-saṅ- ‖
kuḷam aḷirvaḷki baḷke tanag ānt-adhikōgra-virōdhi-sādanam ‖
vaḷike baḷaḷchi nurggi paḷaram tave kondu mahāji-raṅgaḍoḷ ‖
toḷagaḍa gaṇḍan ānt iriye bhumbhukam adbhutan āḍud ettalum ‖
keḍeva-bhaṭar bhaṭāntra-vṛit(t)adandam urulva-hayam hayāḷiyim ‖
puḍivuḍji āge meṭṭuva-gajam gaja-māmsaman urchehhi tiṇḍu kūg- ‖
iḍuva maruḷ maruḷ-paḍeyan aṭṭuva siddha-gaṇam gaṇagaḷam ‖
baḍiva niśācharar ssamara-dhīra . . . . irid āji-raṅgaḍoḷ ‖

ant auēkaram kondu sura-lōkakke bijayam geyyal āṭana magaṇ samadhigata-pañcha-mahā-śabda
mahā-sāmantādhipati vijaya-lakshmī-pati samasta-śāstra-pārāvaḷa-pārāyaṇam ‖ sāmanta-Nārāyaṇam ‖
ripu-baḷa-timira-hāraṇa-karaṇa-sahasrakiraṇam ‖ gaṇḍar-ābharaṇam ‖ nija-kuḷa-kuvalaya-viḍalita-vi-
rāja-rājam ‖ gaṇikā-manōjam ‖ aśva-vidyā-vidita-S’āḷihōtram ‖ Nandana-vana-chhatram baḷādhika-
virōdhi-sādana-Pākasāsanam ‖ gita-Kaṇjāsanam ‖ vividha-vibudha-māgadha-chintāmaṇi ‖ dharaḍhi-
rāja-chūḍāmaṇi ‖ śubhrābhra-kuṇḍēndu-Hara-hāsabhāsa-bhāsura-jagad-akirty-ākaram ‖ satya-
ratnākaram ‖ mṛigarāja-śauryyam ‖ Mandara-dhairyyam ‖ (n)aṇṇana siṅgam ‖ śrīmaj-Jayasimha-Dēvam ‖
vṛitta ‖ muḷis aty-adbhutam āyam endum achaḷam dāṇam budhāhḷādi kē- ‖
vaḷim alt unnuati-satya-śaucham aritam lōkōttaram kīrtti dig- ‖

ripu-sainyam ette dhuradoḷ |
nṛparim munn iṛidu palavu kāḷagaḍoḷ bhū- |
mipa-chūḍāmaṇi Siṃgam |
nṛparim munn iṛivan emba pesaraṃ paḍedaṃ ||

svasti śrîmatu Kajachuryya-bhuja-baḷa-chakravartti-râya-Murâri-Sôvi-Dêva-varshada 10 neya Durm-mati-saṃvatsarada Mâghada puṇṇami-Sômavâradandu ||
kanda || Banavase-nâḍam haḍed int | anunayadim Vikramâṅkan âḷutt iral â- |
Manu-nîti-mârggav oppuva | Dhanaḍa-śrî Kuppatûra sâsirvvakkaḷ ||
sukhav iral ant â-vûram | makhamam kiḍip-asuran-ante kiḍisalu barpp â- |
sukha-rahita-Gavuḍa-Sâmiya | sakharoḷag âg eyde piḍiye pârvvara sereya ||
va || ant â-Gavuḍa-Svâmi-daṇḍanâtham siddhâyamam nereye koṇḍ anyâyadind Uchehaṅgiya Haḍe-Dêvana dhâḷiyam taṇḍu grâmamam mû-valasâgi mutti yiridu sûreyam koṇḍ uḍey urchchi sereyam piḍiye ||
piḍivudum ant â-kshaṇadind | Iḍukeya-Nâyaka-taṇḍanam karaḍâgaḷ |
kaḍu-gaḷi-Kêteya-Nâyaka(nim) | biḍisi stri-gôvan endu besasal asêsha ||
va || antu besasuvudum Mâriya masakad-ante mâ-masakam masagi palara taḷutt iridu sereyam jîva-dhanamumam maguḷchi sura-lôka-prâptan âdan adak asêsha-mahâjanam mechchi netta-goḍagey Satyaśraya-kuḷa-tiḷakam Châḷukyâbharaṇam śrîmatu pratâpa-Jagaḍêkamalla-Dêva-râjyam uttarôtta-râbhipravarddhamânam â-chandra-târam-baram saluttam ire svasti yama-niyama-svâdhyâya-dhyâna-dhâraṇa-maunânushṭhâna-japa-samâdhi-śila-guṇa-sampannar appa śrîmad-anâdi-agrahâram Kuppatûringam Nêriligegam simâ-sambandhadim yuddhamâḍe tu-samayadoḷ avasaram-baḍedu Ku-ppaṭûra sâsirvvara magam ..... ḍeya-Bichaṇana magam Kirttiyaṇṇam miṛi mêre-dappi kaviva-mâr-

Sorab Taluq.

tannoḷag irdda mauktikav iḷâ-dharav adri-dharâṅga-rōchigal |

unnatam âda bal-deregaḷin tere-mâleya nila-rōchiyim |
tann ati-gunpu ghōshad odavim lavaṇâmbudhi nâḍe rāñjikum ||
â-jalanidhi-parivēṣṭisid- | â-Jambū-dvipa-madhyaḍoḷ Mēru-nagam |
râjipud eṇḍeseg amara-sa- | mâḍe sura-dhēnu-dēva-taru-pañchakadim |
â-Mēru-giriya teṅkaṇa-dikkiṇoḷu dharmma-bhūmi Bharata-khaṇḍam irppud adaṛoḷ ati-ramaṇyamâda
nânâ-dēśam uṇṭ â-dēśoḷu ||
Jina-dharmmâvâsav adatt amala-vinayad âgârav âdattu Padmâ- |
sananirp â-sadmav âtaviśada-yaśō-dhâbhav âdattu vidyâ- |
dhana-janma-sthânav âdatt asama-taraḷa-gambhīra-sad-gēhav âdatt |
eṇisalk int uḷḷa nânâ-mahimeyoḷ esugum châru-Karṇṇâṭa-dēśam ||
adan âḷvam śatru-bhūbhṛid-giri-kuḷiśan iḷâ-dâni râjâdhirâjam |
kadana-krīḍâ-Triṇētram pṛithula-bhuja-balâjña-prabhâva-prasiddham |
châduram bâṇa-prayōga-kramade nirupmōdrēgad ēkâṅga-vīram |
Madanâkâram gambhiram Harihara-nṛipan-âtmōdbhavam Dēva-Râyam ||
â-naraṇâtham sukha-saṅkathâ-vinōdadim râjyam gevvuttam ire ||
palavum dēśakke sōmpim sogayipuvudu Karṇṇâṭa-sampūrṇṇa-bhū-man- |
ḍalav â-Karṇṇâṭa-dēśakk atisayam tân eval nâḍe tōrkkum ||
olavind â-dēśav ellam sahajade padiṇeṇṭ agiyum kampaṇaṅgal ||
sale kûṛppind irppuv â-kampaṇaḍoḷ atisayam tân eval nâḍe tōrkkum ||
volavim Nâgara-khaṇḍeyam lalitad â-nâḍiṅge dal Kuppaṭūr |
ttilakam tân enisutta Bhavya-jana-dharmmâvâsadim santatam ||
sale chaityâlayadinde pû-goḷagaḷind udyânadim gandha-śâ- |
ḷi-lasat-kṣētra-nikâyâdinde ramaṇyam-bettu vibhrâjikum ||
pû-late pû-giḍu pû-mara | sâlind allalli kēri-kēṛigaḷoḷ chai- |
tyâlayada munde tumbiya | jâḷam madav ēre merevav â-parimaḷadoḷ ||
â-puramam tân âḷvam | Gōpa-mahâprabhu Jinēśa-dharmma-viśuddham |
sôpânam svarggakk ene | pâpa-rahita-sach-charitradim sogayisuvam ||
â-Gōpa-gauṇḍa-tanayam | sâgara-pariveṣṭisirdda Jambū-dvipakk |
âgaḷ vitaraṇa-vibhavade | Bhōgada Siriyannan esevan eleg apratimam ||
â-Siriyanna-tanûjam | bhâsura-guṇa-nilayan uchita-dâni kṛipâmbhô- |
râśi garuvargge guru Jina- | dâsam Gōpaṇṇan akhila-guṇa-nissimam ||
â-Gōpaṇṇana vitaraṇad ēḷgey ent endode ||
Vârijasadme sadmadoḷag irddavol in-nutisidda pâṛadam |
pâṛade banda-tōrkke sumaṇō-maṇi saṇ-maṇi-hâradalli band- |

śrī śrī-Umā-Kaiṭabhēśvara-dēvaru śrī

namas tuṅga-&c. ||

śrī svasti śrī jayābhyudaya-S'ālivāhana-śaka-varsha 1291 neya saṃdha ēshya parivartamānakke saluva
Vyaya-saṃvatsarada Magha-su 14 Ravivāradallu ashṭa-shashṭi-mahā-liṅga-dēvatā-sārvabhauma |
śrīman-mahā-Virūpāksha-dēvaru Tuṅgabhadrā-tīrada Pampā-kshētra-sthita-padmapīṭha-maṇḍita-
pādāravinda-sēvya-vaibhavakke nija-bhaktar āgi sva-kshētra pannir-chchāsanada Vidyānagarada
ratna-pīṭha śrīmann-āḷva narapatigaḷu | śrīman-mahārājādhirāja paramēśvara Achyuta-Rāya-Nara-
siṃha-Rāya-Krishṇa-Rāyaru Vidyānagaradalu siṃhā-anārūdhar āgi sakala-rājyamam satya-niti-sa-
dharma sukha-sat-kathā-vinōdadi pratipāḷ[su]va kāladallu tat-pāda-padmōpajīvigal āda teṅkaḷu-
nāḍa Banavāse-[pā]ḷunir-chchhaḥsanada Chandragut-vēḷthake saluva Nāgarakhaṇḍada Maḷu-nāḍa
Kupuṭūra-shaḍ-vīma-sthalakke modal āda [pī]ṭhamā-ē-grāma-agrahāra-vobba Chāndrāyāṇi-
sampradāyad i-nāḍa prabhu Saṅkāṇṇape ājuṇāpisida nirūpu i sthala-grāma-agrahāra-muṇṭādakke
pramukha-paṭṭada ...... antu sarvaralu prārambhēṇa madhya-bhāgāntyav āda divi-rātrā-yāmā-
raddha-ghaṭikā-sandhigalallu parikshā-paṇḍita pratisl t'vāpita an-udgha-vijaya-prathama-sēvē pratha-
ma-prasāda-prathama-tāmbū-a-anugupa-svakiya-[ya]jamāna-mudrā-vichārārtha i-dīva-rātrā-yāmā-
al-āda || dharmmakkē nigamā-sama-tantrōkta-kriyādi-nitya-kaṭṭaḷe-utsāha-pañcha-parva-manvāḍi-ja-
yanti-modal-āda naimittikada ā li-madhyānna-satrāḍi-dharmma-visēsha-kaṭṭaḷe-upādhivantaru Saiva-
nissavana-yōga-bhōga-vaibhavakke saluva baṭṭaḷ-kandāchāra-vargakkau vētrānkita-svatantra-
kartugaḷ āgi i-nāḍa grāmaḍōḷage baṭṭa dēvasva-brahmadāya-puravarga-munṭāda nānā-dharmmagaḷoḷu
mēlu-biḍu-nyūna-pūrṇa-vihita-v-chāraṇā na la pr[e]gaḷinda saluva tere siddhāya arevasa migite
mēluvaṇa simegaḷallu suṅka-charadāya-sistu-kaṭṭaḷegaḷa prahara-pramāṇa-vichāra-mēlu-visa-koḍa-
visa saha vartakarige saluva mānya-maryād gaḷannu nadasikoṭṭu saluvaṭa sadā Bilikāra-sīma-stha-
ḷakke mātrābhimānar āgi naḍa dēva-prabhugaḷu vyavahārgaḷu modalādayarinda pūrvārabhya
nadasikoṇḍu bāha mānya-lal uchita-parivarttane-modalāddanu barasikoṇḍu ichchha-pūrṇa-mānya-
maryād gaḷi .. mi kāryasthan āgi vāhatyāsana-ratha-vāhanan isi koṇḍu iḍabāhabagye ibanagi
koṭṭuḍu (here follow details of grant) bhū-

(back) ‡ śrī śrī-Chintāmaṇi-Nārasimha-prithivī-uddhāra-Varāha-dēvara sākshi-mudre ‡ miyallu silā-
sthāpanavannu māḍisi ninu nimma vamśakke svēchchhādi-dāna-krayakke upabhōgisikoṇḍu ayā-
chita-abhyāgata-mārgastharāgi banda prāṇigaḷige anna-vastra-munṭādannu śaktyānusāra dharmma-
vannu naḍasikōbhaḍu yendu tāvu Koṅkanake ari-kaṭaka-viṭa [ya]kke teraḷuvāga namisal āgi appaṇē-
pramāṇa āṇḍōḷika-sattige-sūrapōna-munṭādi śastra-padā-i-sahita śauryōdāra-parākramadi dhīran āgi
āhaḍu yendu baraḍu pālisida śāsanake śrī-Virūpāksha (usual final verse) .......

svasti śrī Kamathakshētrada Kunta'a-durgādhishṭhita-pūrva-praktha i-Vaisākha-sudha-paurṇami-
chandrōpariga-punya-kāladaln śrī dēvarige dēsika-pavamāna-sahasra-nāma-nandādipa-naivēdya-
saparvake koṭaḍu Brahma-Nārā .. puravadake chokka 4 nu va | nārā | visā | Daṇakānārige vritti
saha i-nuvva-kāl-dalu Krishṇārpanadi keṭya dharmma maṅgaḷa mahā śrī śrī-Virūpāksha . . . . . .
chā 4 ia 18 ēkatrā sa 100 sakrasadaseka . . . . . . . . . . Sidhāḍi-matadavaru punya-kulanū paruāra-
kiraka . . . . samel-ābas hrage kāhokevekā āla muve (rest contains details of gift).

* The orthography of * here and in many other places is very bad. ‡ This matter is inscribed at the top. † In kanarese.

rum | vādi-kula-kōḷahalarum | avupisānagnihōtra-dvija-zuru-pūjā tatpararum | vidvāṃsa-kaḷamba-hṛtu-

bhūvana-vikhyāta-pañcha-śata-vīra-śāsana-labdhānēka-guṇa-gaṇānvitā-satya-sauchāchāra-chāritra-
naya-vinaya-vijñāna-vīra-virātavāra-Vīra-Baṇañju-sameya-dharmma-pratipākararuṃ | naya-vinaya-
viśuddha-guḍḍa-Garuḍa-dhvajaruṃ | virājita-māuṇānva-vīra-lakṣam-puḷikita-harṣa-saḍānandanaruṃ |
sāhasa-sata-baḷa-tri-bhuvana-parākramōnnataruṃ | Baladēva-Vāsudēva-Khaṇḍaḷa-Mūḷabhadra-vam-
śōdbhavaruṃ | balu-kidaṇḍa-hastaruṃ | tammoḷēka-hastaruṃ | ēkaika-viraruṃ | lōkaika-mānya-
ruṃ | nuḍidaute gaṇḍaruṃ | gaṇḍaroḷu gaṇḍaruṃ | kalaṇa-prachandaruṃ | bhaya-lōbha-durlabha-
ruṃ | satya-Rādhēyaruṃ | śaucha-Gāṅgēyaruṃ | ā-hettum vade-vadiyade sōladaruṃ | neredeḍe nāju
gaḷuṃ | haradaḍe mam .. gaḷuṃ | hog-valli hullu ikkuvaruṃ | āḷikaruṃ | baṇḍār-kāgaruṃ |
koḷvadake Javanannaruṃ | baladalli Bḍiyannaruṃ | chhaladalu Daryōdhanaruṃ | tyāgadalu
Karṇṇanannaruṃ | bhōgadalu Indranannaruṃ | guṇpinala mahā-samudramam pōluvaruṃ | duṣṭa-
chatuṣṭayara laṭe-hoṭe-niṭelu-gōṇḷayam mugida tēḍu būli-kombarum | Brahma-rakṣasage horag-
oḍḍan oḍḍuvaruṃ | kesara kicheḍiḍuvaruṃ | desege bobbiḍuvaruṃ | hōha | Māriya challav-āḍuvaruṃ |
dana Māriyan iḍirggombaruṃ | bārada Mirige baḷiyan aṭṭuvaruṃ | yidda Mīrige biḍḍan ikkuvaruṃ |
bet-ēri muttuva karevaruṃ | Javana miseyan oḍal uyyal-āḍuvaruṃ | mittuvaṃ toṭṭa-nāḍy āḷuvaruṃ |
araḷiya hūtaraliya tiguḍa rakkasana dēbeya bēḷudingaḷa noreya hebbuliya giṇṇu āsareya gōsaney ..
bidi baichadavam piḍidu pāḍa-mārgga-ja-ā-mārgga li nani-pattaṇavam pokku chakravarttiya māṇikya-
bhaṇḍiravam tivi mikka-drabyaman ābhā ābhaya-baiśajya-śāstra-dāna-vinōdgaḷuṃ | kaṣṭūrikāmōda-
ruṃ | haya-Vatsa-Rājaruṃ | rāja-gṛha-pūjitaruṃ | āśrita-jana-kalpa-vṛkṣaruṃ | gōtra-pavitra-
chintāmaṇigaḷuṃ | kaṇka-kañchuḷike-Kāma-lēvaruṃ | chēḷibharapa-bhūṣitaruṃ | śrīmatu Kanaka-
Dēvana karumāḍalu Honamba tettisida agapita-pratāpa-Laṅkēśvararuṃ | śrī-vīra-lakṣmi-nandana-
vanābhīṣṭa-Vasantaruṃ | Cōḷ-kul-intakaruṃ | nāmādi-samasta-praśasti-sahitaṃ | chaturu-yugabaṭā-
rābhidhāna-paramparāya-nāmamappa śrīmad-anādi-agrahāraṃ Baṇañju-aḍi-vaṭṭanam Jambadvīpa-
śrōmani śrīmatu Bhagavati-dēvi-labdha-vara-prasādonnatarum appa Ayyaḷaveya aynūrvva-svāmigaḷuṃ |
eppatta-ēḷu-kōṭi-ghaṭika.. nakke āchāryyara pratiṣṭhisuvalli samasta-praśasti-sahita dakṣiṇa-
Ayyāvaḷe .. ha Kōṭiśvara la śrīmad-rāja-guru-mahā-vālū-Rudraśakti-dēvargge koṭṭa śāsana-kra.. v
ent enduḍe ā-Kōṭiśvara-dēvara yaṅga-bhōga-raṅga-bhōgakke nāḍab i-prathama-staḷa | ya-haḷḷi-
gaḷuṃ .. vṛtti-valita-varttanegeya dharmma nakke | sakaḷa-sāmyav ellavay ā-chandrārkka-tāraṃ-baraṃ
dharmma stivar āgali yendu | dharmmava pratiṣṭhisidaru yā stālakkeyuṃ | yā-dharmmakeyyuṃ |
yāchāryya-Rudraśkti-dēvarggeyuṃ | yāvananbu vobbanu rāja-gimitva māḍiḍuḍe | chōra-gāmitva
māḍiḍuḍe | tu-janatvavuṃ māliḍaḍe | parush-ivēshava māḍiḍuḍe | vikarmma ya kartabyagata gaya-
nava māḍidavanu Brāhmaṇan | Kṣatriya | Vaiśya | Sūdra yt-nālku-jātiyotage āvavana kondaḍuṃ jāti-
vijātiyatiy enlu ha ḍhḍiḍa | yeti nuḍ vavinu yashtāṅga-drōhanup yay ā-vvarigeyuṃ | ēḷu-vare-
banonda-varigeyuṃ | nālku nāḍigeyuṃ | haḍineṇṭu-sameyakeyū | kūḍe drōhi nāḍ-āḷataiya sāyasāluva-
nu yavag-yatti sārisalilla | o ṭṭu baisalilla | āvan oḍḍ haṭahariyite haṇidu | biḍḍadē koṛaḍu |
yir lavanē biravanuṃ samudram uta | yihāuge māḍ ita yiralu Ayyāvaḷeya yaynūrvvara koṭṭa-kelasa |
kaṇḍuvare n garu | yiridavanē Biravaṇiga-vijaya | iyi-maryyādeyannu seṭṭi-gatta miṇḍa saudarē bira-
vaṇ gū bir karu-arkhvigi sa nasta-sameya-vāḍigaḷu koṭṭu | drōhi siyāra koṇ ḍuṃ Rudraśkti-dēva-
dēvaṃ pinvakk | viḷiṭṭi | i-pipakke hoṛigu | sameya-vāḍiḍē māḍi lavaru | Kōṭīśvararu embudu
dakṣiṇa-Ayyāvaḷ | ā-bāḷu-brahmachārī āḍiyāgi āru mata-goṭṭ dam ayinūrvvara mukhyavāgi samu-
dṛa-matavāgi koṭṭu du | maṅgaḷa mahā śrī śrī

vaṇi-stuti-pātra sakala-saukhya-nidhānam |
kṣōṇi-taḷadoḷu chelvina |
gaupōttarav eniku Vāṇakhēḍa-su-dēsam ||
ā-nāḍa Dēpagēva |
māṇōnnata Sōma-Dēva-Vāṇeyan adhikam |
dīnānātha-su-mitram |
nānā-guṇa-bhūṣaṇam jitāhita-gōtram ||
satu-putran appa Ravi-Dēva-Vāṇeyana pratāpōnnati ent endaḍe |
vara-mūrtti-Kāma-dēvam |
para-nāri-sahōdaram pratāpa-nidhānam |
dhare mechche satya-sāgara |
ari-nṛpa-kājāgni-Rudran i-Ravi-Dēvam ||
sarbbēśvara-sachchhiṣyam |
sarbhārtthi-brāta-kalpa-kujan ati-tējam |
parbbida kirttig adhisam |
saibba-kaḷā kuśalan ārjitam Ravi-Dēvam ||
vandi-jana-kalpa-vṛkṣham |
saṇḍani-simhādi-biruda-bhūṣita-sāuryyam |
Nandisa-nātha-bhaktam |
kuṇḍendu-vilāsa-kirttiy i-Ravi-Dēvam ||
antu negaḷda Ravi-Dēvana paṭṭa-mahā-dēviy appa Mallu-bāyiyara guṇaguḷōnnati ent endaḍe |
pati-[h]ite sādhu sad-guṇi yaśōvati(m)unṇata-dharmma-mūrtti ūrj- |
jita-nija-gōtra-bhūṣaṇe jana-stute yāchaka-kāmadhēnu san- |
nuta-mahaniya-vaibhava-guṇāspade Mallu-bāyiy end |
ati-mudadinde(m)baṇṇisuvud i-Ravi-Dēvana kānte[yam]janam ||
antu negaḷda Ravi-Dēva-Vāṇeyagam Mallu-bāyigam janiyisida su-putra-kula-dīpaka end enisida Sōyi-
Dēvana pratāpav ent endaḍe |
jala-nidhi-vēṣṭhita-vasudhā- |
valeya-nuṭam chhalada balada vikrama-guṇad u- |
jvala-kirtti Sōyi-Dēvam |
phalita-sura-kṣā... vandi-janatānanda ||
dhareyolu māṛimp adatara |
yiṛuḷu hagal agasi toḷaldu kāṇaḍe Sōyam |

sura-lōkadōḷage kaligaḷan |
aṣasuva teṛadinda Yindra-puramam pokkam ||
A-Sōyi-Dēvaṇim kiriya Ekkama-Dēvana pratāpav ent endade ||
ari-biruda-sūre-kāṛam |
para-hita-nirata vṛita-pratāpa-sahāyam |
sphurad-uru-kītti-vilāsam |
vara-putram Mallu-bāyi-Ekkama-Dēvam ||
tad-anujan apa Vikrama-Dēvana pratāpav ent endade ||
vīraḍoḷu Vikramānkan u- |
dārada Raviṣūnu dhairyya-sāgaran amalam |
chārutara-charita guṇa-gaṇa- |
rārājita-nija-kuḷabdhi Vikrama-Dēvam ||
Kāḷamukha-chūḷāmaṇi |
Bhāḷēkṣaṇa-mūrtti Ru .. sakti-yatipam |
pāḷita-vibudha-brāta nṛi- |
pāḷaka-Simhaṇa-vinūta-chāritran ||
jayati vitata-kītti ḥ saj-janānanda-mūrttiḥ
śrita-jana-paripārttir dhamma-kāri kṛitārtthi |
nata-jana-gata bhitir vairṇṇam datta-bhitiḥ
śruti-nikara-su-nītir bbhūtalē Rudrasaktiḥ ||

..... Sarbbēśvara-dēvana guṇōnnatiy ent endade ||
sō'yam Sarbbēśvarō bhāti jīta-kalpa-drumōnnatiḥ |
brahmāṇḍa-maṇḍaḷi chitrā ya .. mntaḥpurāyatē ||

anta negaḷda Vikrama-Dēvanu Saka-varushada || 1172 Saumya-saṃvatsarada Srāvaṇada paurnnami-
Sōmavāra-byatipāṭad andu śri-Kōṭīśvara-dēvara sannidhānadalli tanna puṇya-sati Ellaha-Dēvi-
sahita śrimat-rūpa-grāma-thā-vi-l-ekkoṭi-chakravartti-Ruḷvasakti-dēvara kayyalu Sarbbēśvara-
dēvara muṇḍiṭṭi mū .... yaḷu gaḍyaṇa la bhatta koṭṭu matta ... reya keḷage Sirada gaddeyaṇa
koṇḍu tauna tande Ravi-Dēva-Vāṇeya Mallu-bāyi Sōyi-Dēva Ekka-Dēva yint ivaru sahita tandeya
deseyali ippaṭṭondu tāya deseyoḷu ippaṭṭondu kulaḷnu salisalu vēḍi devasa haṭṭu-mānisa-brāhmaṇa-
bhōjanakke chhatra-dharmmavanu māḍi Rūḍrasakti-dēvara kaiyalu eḍa-gaiyanu koṭṭu ā-Rudrasakti-
dēvaru tanna surāḷa-gimiy āgi chandrādityan uḷḷanaka nāḍasi pāḷisuvaru (usual final
phrases and verses) yi-dharmmavanu māḍida Ekka-Dēva Ellaha-Dēvi ā-chandrārkka-tāram-bara
stira-jīvi maṅgaḷa mahā śrī śrī

śrīmatē Kōṭināthāya paramānanda-mūrttayē ||
sarvva-bhūta-hitārtthāya jagat-kāraṇa-kirttayē ||
śrīmad-Gaṅgā-taraṅgōcchal ta-kaṇa-lavaṇa-mauktikōdbhūṣa-jūṭam ||
vyōmātmēndūgrarōchi-prithuvi-hutavaham mārutāmbhōṣṭa-mūrttam ||
Vāmas Saḍyōdbhav-Īśāny atha Tatpuruṣahāgōra-sat-pañcha-vaktram ||
śrīmat-Kōṭīśam Īśam sakala-jana-manōbhīṣṭamam māḍug endum ||
ka || oppuva Nāgarakhaṇḍadoḷ ||
irppudu tāu agrahāra vasudhā-ramaṇi- ||
darppa-stāṇāgrahāraṃ ||
tappad enal Kuppaṭūru ramaṇiyateyim ||
taradind oppuva dēvatā-bhavanadim poṇ-goṇṭyim chelvan āld ||
re saudha-grahadim lasad-vipaṇi-vidhi-mārggadim khātikā- ||
parivēṣṭy-antaradim chaḷat-sa ...... haṅgaḷim vēśya-man- ||
diradindam ugra Kuppaṭūc kkaram ad êm kang êm bedaṅg adudō ||
ēḷisit Aḷakā-puramam ||
chāḷisit Amarāvati-lasat-pura-varamam ||
mēḷisitu Bhōgavatig ene ||
pōlipu .. ...... n abhirāmateyam ||
aut ā-grāmāntaradoḷu ||
Kailāsādriyan ēḷisi ||
pāḷisuvem bhakuta-janaman emb i-bharadim ||
Sūli bhavāni-samētam ||
lileyin eḷtandu ninda Kōṭinātham ||

āḍuva navilum virahige |
sūḍam māḍuva lāṭa-vanaṃ paura-vanaṃ ||
tāmarasa-kumuda-kuṭmala- |
hēma-sarōjam rathāṅga-kuravaka-ainadam |
kōmaḷa-bharitam chalitam |
sāmaja-nivaham taṭaka paura-taṭakam ||

va | antu virājisuv Ananta-Kōṭīśvara-tribhuvanauka-rakṣā-maṇiyan āśrayis irdda | svasti yama-niyama-svādhyāya-dhyāna-dhāraṇa-mōnānuṣṭhāna-japa-tapa-samādhi-śila-guṇa-sampannarum sakala-vidvaj-jana-prasannarum Kug-Yajus-SāmAtharvaṇa-chatur-vvēda-vēdārththa-praviṇarum (y)ati-chatur-vvi-kāra-kārakarum | pratipaksha-tārkkika-manōgarvva-parvvata-chchhhēdana-vajra-daṇḍarum upanyāsa-girvvāṇa-vāṇī-tarat-taraṅgarum Sīvāgama-vārdhdhana-vardhdhana-sudhākararum vādi-gaja-mastaka-śūlarum chaturddaśa-pramāuānvita-prasiddha-pratīpaty-anavadya-hridya-nitya-jñānānanda-para-Sīva-sva-rūpāvalōkana-tat-svarūparum yati-sārvvabhaumarum yekkoṭi-samaya-chakravartti-saptāhattari-sthānāchāryyarum śrī-svayambhu-Kōṭinātha-dibya-śrī-pāda-padmārādhakarum duḥ-karmma-bādbakarum appa Rudraśakti-dēvara tapa-prabhāvam ent endaḍe ||

vṛ | kāmavan ervvi krōdhaman aḍarppisi lōbhaman eyde tūḍi mat- |
tam muḷisinde mōhad aḷavam perapīṅgisiy unmadāṅgaḷam |
sāmaḍi nūṅki mātsariyamam biḍe pārisid enalke matt |
ā-muni-puṅgavaṅge Hara-mūrttigey ar ddore Rudraśaktiyo |
Girijeya saṅgam illada Marunnadiyo | samasallad āvagam |
maruḷa gaṅgaṅgaḷ berasiy āḍa . . . . . . kapāḷa hastaḍo |
dharisida ruṇḍa-māḷe koraḷall inis illada S’ambhuv embud ī- |
śvara-vara-mūrttiy embudu yatindran-aṭandrana Rudraśaktiyam ||

va | ant eṇisirdda yatisvaram Rudraśakti-mahā-mahimara prēmānujaṃ vinēya-jana-kalpa-bhūjan ēkāka-vākyan ubhaya-bhava-sāphalya tri-karaṇa-śuddha chatur-vvidha-tantra-sāra Pañchabāṇa-vidhvamsana ari-shaḍ-vargga-vichchhēdana sapta-bāyasana-varjjita aṣṭa-mada-nivāraṇa nava-nidhi-sanātha daśa-diśā-dhavalita-kīrttiy ēkādaśa-Rudrāvatāra dvādaśāditya-pratāpan eṇisida Chikka-Sarvvēśvaraśakti-dēvara mahā-mahimey ent endaḍe ||

vṛ | vanamam pokka Vasantakam bhayade puttam pokkan ā-chandramam |
jīuguttum biḍe pāriḍatt aḷi-kuḷam teṇ-gāḷi meyyokkuv inn |
eṇag ārum nerav illa matte gelal inn ēn ārppen end Aṅgajam |
tanuvam bī[ . . ] si bhītigondan enal inn ēn embe Sarvvēśanā |
Kāḷāmukha-bratānvaya- |
śila-guṇam Sīva-kathādy-anēka-smṛty-ar- |
tthālaṅkāra-sāra-vākyam |
pālita-saj-jana-vinuta-yāti Sarvvēśam ||
koraḷoḷu kap[ ]raḍoḷu pere |
piridum jaḍeyalli Gāṅge toḍeyoḷu Sīve matt |
uraḍoḷu karōṭi tolagida |
Haran embudu yati-varēnya-Sarvvēśvaraṇa ||

vṛ | jaḍeyind oppuva Parpachāpa-sita-bhasmōddhūḷitāṅgakke nēr- |
ppaḍed irdd aṅgaja-mitra-chārutara-kāśā-prachchha’ta-chchhhēdittakk |
ēḍegoṭṭ ippa śasāṅkan emba nuḍiyam lōkakke nīchaysidam |
gaḍa tān endoḍ ad ē-vogaḷḍapudo peḷ Sarvvēśa-yōgīndranaḷ ||
kāgraṇiyam raḷ egelda bharadim Md anam |

nigrahadinde sa-yōga-sa- |

irad att ādoḍe pēḷal en ariyen ettam bannadḍhan āg |
ire nind irḍḍoḍe vugra-kōpa-śikhiyindam bhasmam ēn āgaḍē |
dharaṇi-maṇḍalamum Haram Tripuramam suṭṭante Sarvvēśanā |
siḍila poḍarppuv ugratara-Māriya māmasakam gajāriyoḷ |
toḷarḍa parākvamam taraṇi-maṇḍalaḍ ēlgeya tēja-rāji nōr- |
ppaḍe laya-kāla-rudran-uru-mūrttate Bhairavan-anta-raudra nēr- |
ppaḍid ire Chikka-dēva-yatipāgraṇiyoḷ nele-goṇḍu ninduḍō ||

hechchida kōpāṇaḷa nosa- |

ire || svasti samadhigata-pañcha-mahā-śabdam Dvārāvati-pura-varādhīśvaram Viṣṇu-vamśōdbhavam

mad-Ananta-Kōṭināthana mahātmeyam kēḷdu vikasita-hṛidayan āgi ||

naḍe nōḍalu Divarājag Amarāvati ..|

āpa ....... enipa |

...... nipa guṇadi |
.... pati-bhaku .. Kāḷa-Gavuḍa mahātma ||
ā-vibhuvina sati Lakshmī- |
dēvige Pārvvatige Ratige Rambhege migil end |
āvaga baṇṇisugum dhare |
bhū-viditeya Kāñchi-Gauḍiyam padapiṇḍam ||

va || ant ā-Gāvaṇiga-kula-pradīpakam śrīman-nāḷ-prabhu-Kāḷa-Gavuḍaṅgam parivāra-chintāmaṇiy

ātana priyānujaṃ tām |
bhūtaḷadoḷu sarvva-śāstra-kuśalan en vi- |
khyāta-yaśam sale negaḷdam |
māt ēm gaḷa Jōma-Gauṇḍan āhava-śauṇḍam ||

va || ant ā-mūvarum chāgada chalada nanniy-olpin .... dim prajeyam pāḷisi Tareyūru-paṇṇeraḍak-

śīva-pāda-śēkharam nava- |
yuvati-manōramaṇa nanniyoḷu Dinapasutam |
bhuvana-jana-prastutyam |
kavi-jana-surabhūja .... pa Tāraka-Gauḍam ||
osedire vibudha-janaṅgaḷu |
jasad eseva yuvati-nivaha .... vad eḍeyoḷ |
kusidire virōdhi-varggam |
pasarisidam kīrtti-lateyan ā-chandrārkkam ||

antu negaḷda Tāraka-Gauḍan-agra-mahisiya guṇa-prabhāvav ent ene ||

nuta-śaubhāgyadoḷ Avanije |
satatam chāritradind Arundhatiy enipa |
pati-bhakte Kāmiyakkaṃ |
kshitiyoḷu Pārvvatiya permmeyam sale taḷeda |
Tāraka-Gauḍaṅg oppuva |
nīraja-daḷa-nayane Kāmiyakkaṅg olavim |
dhāriṇi baṇṇisal ogedam |
chāru-kaḷadhāra .... Kāḷa-Gavuḍam ||
Udayādriyinde dinakaran |
udadhiyin amṛtāṃśu vudayidipant udayisidam |
madavad-ari-marddanam bhū- |
vidita-yaśam Kāḷa-Gauḍa Bhava-pada-bhaktam ||

yerada budhāvaḷige Dinapasutanoḷ maṛkkoṇḍ |
ari-samitige Marutajanoḷ |

â-vibhuvin-anuga-ḍammaṃ |
bhû-vaḷyadoḷ adaṭin ârppin eḷtaradindaṃ |
pâvana-sugaṇḍa-tīrttaṃ |
Bhīvaṇanaṃ poḷva puṇyavāśigaḷ oḷarē ||

Manu-charita sujana-yutan enal |

lōkam baṇṇise Tāraka |

svasti samasta-bhuanāśrayam śrī-pṛthvī-vallabham mahārājādhirāja paramēśvara parama-bhaṭṭārakaṃ Satyāśraya-kuḷa-tiḷakam Chāḷukyābharaṇam śrīmad-Bhuvanaykamaḷa-Dēva-vijaya-rājyam uttarōttarābhivṛddhi-pravarddhamānam ā-chandrārkka-tāram saḷuttam ire Vaṅkāpurada nelevīḍinoḷu sukha-saṅkathā-vinōdadim rājam geyye tatu-pāda-padmōpajīvi || svasti samadhigata-pañcha-mahā-śabda-mahā-sāmantādhipati mahā-prachaṇḍa-daṇḍanāyakan asthāna-vastu-nāyaka niyōga-Yōgandharāyaa ṇam chatura-pārāyaṇam vivēka-vidyādharam sakaḷa-kaḷā-dharam vikramōttuṅgam asahāya-siṅgam śrīmad-Bhuvanaykamaḷa-Dēva-pādāravinda-shaṭcharaṇam śrīman-mahā-pradhāna hiri-sandhi-vigrahi maneverggaḍe-daṇḍanāyakan Udayādityam ||

jagam ēka-chehhatram āyat urkkida dharaṇidhara-drōhar akkāḍidar bhū- |
nagaram sindhūra-mudrāṅkitam enisidud anyāvanipāḷakar kai- |
mugid ettam tettu. . nyāvaśa. . . . āgirddud . . cha- |
krige tanninda. . . . . . vīrano negard Udayādityam daṇḍādhinātham ||
idiṟoḷ Rāvaṇa. . . . mārmmaḷedoḍam gelgum jagam bēḍi band |
idiṟoḷ nindadam igum it evaradakk am innam ittam kaṟutt |
idiṟ āgim kavitandu bēḍim iṟigum pūṇḍ igum end andu bāṟpp |
Udayādityanoḷ anmin-ārppin-esekam meyvattu kaṅg oppugum ||

dvipaṃ dēśangal-olage Kannada-dēśam |
rūpu-vibhavadali satya-dē-|
ḷapadi sogayisutam irppav atimudadindam ||


Among the continents, Jambudvipa; among the countries, the Kannada country; in beauty and glory, the true land, thus it shines with great joy.

phala-bharav āda śāli taḷḷ ēṛida chūta-kujāli teṅgu kaṇ- |
goḷisuva kauṅgu pūta late pū-giḍu pū-maraḍoḷi pallavaṇ- |
gaḷa poḷap ondi tām nimirva śāka-kujam tiḷi-nir-ggoḷaṅgaḷim |
sulalitāv āgi rañjipudu Nāgarakhaṇḍam ad etta noḷpadam ||

jñāna-vyāpakar appa Bhavya-janadim vidvaj-janānīkadim |

â-purada madhya-pradēśadoḷu ||
oḷakoṇḍ abhraman eyde chumbip Udaya-śri-śalav ā-bhānu-maṇ- |
ḍalavəy embavoḷ unnatōnnataḍol â-chaityālayam chenna poū- |
gaḷasam rañjise bhittigaḷ poḷapu-dōṛalg ā-mahā-sadmadoḷ |
vilasat-pārśva-Jinēśan irppan adaroḷ dēvādhidēvēśvaram ||
ant â-purad adhipati bhū- |
chintāmaṇi Gōpa-Gauḍa-suta-Buḷḷappaṅg |
int udayisi Gōpaṇṇam |
Kantu-samākṛtiyoḷ oppuvam vasumatiyoḷ ||
Jina-sad-dharmamam ellam tiḷipi matt â-mūla-san-mantramam |
nenevutt enuttal echcharisidam Siddhānta-yōgindran ā- |
tana kāruṇyamam appukeydu mudadim sarvvajña-pādābja-van- |
daneyam māḍuta dharmmadinda nadevaṃ Gōpaṇṇa-Bhavyōttamam ||
Gōpativāhana-prabheyan ēḷisi Gōpati-vāhanāmśumam |
rūpu-giḍalke jaṛedu Gōpati-vāhana-kāntiyam mahā- |
tōpade tāne nindisi manōharad ēlgeyol-opputam bahu- |
dvipaman eyde parvvidudu Gōpaṇṇa-aggaḍa-kīrtti pāṇḍuram ||

punaḥ ||
akhaṇḍatara-paṇḍitya-maṇḍitānana-maṇḍalaḥ |
Paṇḍitācharyya-varyyō’syākhaṇḍa-śri-kāraṇam kila ||
yat-kāruṇya-katāksha-vikshita-pumān lakshmi-patis syāt kila |
yat-pādānati-mānitāmala-manās satyam Mahēśah kila |

ēkō nivarttayati durggati-mārggatō yam |
anyō’hi darśayati nirvṛti-vartma yasya |
yau Paṇḍita-Śruta-munī munipau tayōs tat |
tad-Gōpaṇasya bhuvi puṇyam agaṇyam atra ||

matte ||
Jina-pada-sarōja-bhṛṅgam |
Jina-vāṇi-vāri-dhauta-kalila-malaugham |
Jina-muni-jana-pāda-bhaktam |
vinayādhyam Gōpa-Gauḍan akhila-guṇādhyam ||
intu kīrttig āvāsav āgirdd u punaḥ ||
anyadā guṇa-māṇikya-bhūshaṇam Gōpa-prabhuḥ |

svasti śrīmati Mūla-saṅgha-tilakē śrī-Nandi-saṅghōdbhavē
svachhē Pustaka-gachchha-śālini śubhē Dēśi-gaṇē yas sukhī |

śrīmān ēṣa jayati ayam S’ruta-muniḥ kaivalya-janmāvaṇiḥ ||
śiṣyas tasya munēs tasya kṛpāmṛta-bharair ujīvayan pāvanaḥ
syād-vādachhalataś chid-ambara-talē dēdīpyamānas sadā |
dinam viśvam idam kṛpāmṛta-bharair ujīvayan pāvanaḥ

sampūrṇṇamāla-mānasaḥ Kali-yugē śrēyāṃs cha Gōpītaṭēḥ |

ddūram Buḷḷapa ity ayam prabhur ayam khyāty-ātmanā śōbhatē ||

śrímat-gambhíra-syád-vádâmôgha-láhchchhanam |
jíyat trailôkya-náthasya śásanam Jína-śásanam ||
ságara-vári-vêshṭita-samasta-dhará-ramaṇi-ghana-staná-|
bhôgav id eminam vidita-vistṛita-sáratarágraháradim |
Nâgarakhaṇḍa-patra-parivêshṭaṇḍim jana-nêtra-puṭriká-|
rágaman ittu mâṇḍude manas-sukha-dam Banavási-maṇḍalam ||
baḷasida nandanávaligaḷim śuka-saṅkuḷadim pikâḷiyim |
baḷed eragirdḍa śáli-vanadim bhramarâḷiyin ikshu-váṭiyim |
tiḷigoḷadim latá-bhavanadim kamalâkaradim kumudvatí-|
kuḷadin id êm manaṅgolipuḍô satatam Banavási-maṇḍalam ||
adan âḷvan akhila-ripu-nṛipa-|
mada-marddanan artthaham paded ivam |
pada-naṭa-raksha-daksham |
vidita-yaśam Sôvi-Dêva-bhútaḷanátha ||
â-Kâḍamba-kuḷa-ṭilakana vikrama-prakramav ent endaḍe ||
adaṭar mmeyyikke birar birudan uḷidu kumbikke vidvishṭa-bhúpar |
mmadavam biṭṭikke śêshâkshataman ôsekar sarvvasvamam ba-|
ḷḷidarum ṭandikke mâṛant avanipa-satiyar kkaṇṇa-nír ikke púṇḍ i-|
kkidan â-Chaṅgâḷva-dhátripatige niḷalavam Sôvi-Dêva-kshitíśam ||
(ka) || madavad-aráṭṭiyam tavisal aggala-gaṇṇa Kaḍamba-Rudran em-|
bude pesar ugra-maṇḍalika-gaṇḍara dâvaṇi embudê diṭakk |
adirad aráṭṭi-maṇḍalika-Bhairavan embude Sôvi-Dêva-em-|
bude Nigaḷaṅkamalla-nṛipan embude satya-paṭákan embudê ||
ka || para-nṛipa-bandhakanê gaṇ-|
ḍara dâvaṇi kaliye maṇḍalika-Bhairavan êm |
sthira-satya-vákyanê husi-|
vara súḷam Sôvi-Dêvan anupama-bhávam ||
Nâgarakhaṇḍam Banavaseg |
âgikkum bhúshaṇam-bol ant adaroḷag im-|
bági sale Tevarateppam |
nâga-latá-púga-vanadin asadaḷav esegum ||
â-Tevarateppad adhipati |
bhútaḷapati Sôvi-Dêva-pada-yugaḷa-sarô-|
játa-mada-madhukaram vi-|
khyáta-yaśam Boppa-Gauṇḍan áhava-śauṇḍa ||
vṛitta || Amarêyyam mantradoḷ śauchadoḷ Amaranadijam prajá-pâḷana-pra-|
kramadoḷ Dharmmâtmajam saprabhuteyoḷ amalâbjêkshaṇam niśchayam tá-|
ne mahí-lôkâgraḍoḷ Gâvaṇa-kuḷa-ṭilakam Boppa-Gâvuṇḍan end en-|
du manas-samprítiyim baṇṇipud akhila-dhará-chakrav ánandadindam ||
â-Tevarateppad adhipa-|
khyátiya nân êṇan-ênan abhivarnṇisuvem |
bhútaḷame táne baṇṇipuḍ |
îtane guṇiy endu Boppa-Gauḍanan aniśam ||

â-vibhuvina sati Lakshmī- |
Dēvige saubhāgya-bhāgya-lakshaṇa-guṇa-sad- |
bhāvakṛitiyindam mēl |
bhū-viditam Châvikabbe-Gavuḍi nitanta ||
vṛitta || Saṇḍada Bammi-Seṭṭi-Guṇi-Bhavya-śikhāmaṇi-Kalli-Seṭṭigal |
maṇḍala-vandyar-annar oḍavuṭṭidaḷ emb init alla Boppa-Gâ- |
vuṇḍana permme-vetta sati sarvva-guṇanvite Châvikabbe-Gâ- |
vuṇḍiy enalke baṇṇisadar âr bhuvanântaraḍoḷ nirantaram |
â-mahâ-prabhuv eṇippa Tevarateppaḍa Boppa-Gâvuṇḍaṅgam Châvikabbe-Gâvuṇḍigam ||
ka || Udaya-giriyim dinâdhipan |
udadhiyin amṛitâṃśu-maṇḍalam śuktikeyind |
oḍavida mauktikav ogevant |
udayisidam Lôka-Gauṇḍan emba mahâtma ||
vṛitta || âtana mâte mâtu dhare âtana pûṇkeye mikka pûṇke sand- |
âtana baṇṭe baṇṭu negaḷd-âtana buddhiye śuddha-buddhi mikk- |
âtana sâhasam nereye sâhasav end abhivarnṇikum dhari- |
trîtalav âgaḷum Tevarateppaḍa nâḷ-Prabhu Lôka-Gauṇḍana ||
vṛitta || ettisidam Jinêndra-gṛihamam dhare baṇṇisal eyde tanna mey- |
vattisidam prajâ-prakaravam ripu-varggaḍa bâya bâgiloḷ |
tettisidam palar bheḍare kûr-alagam nija-kīrtti-vaḷḷiyam |
paṭṭisidam dig-antavan id êm kṛitakṛityano Lôkan urvviyoḷ ||
ka || kege bâvi dêvatâ-gṛihav |
agavaṇṭige satrav emb ivam paḍi salipam |
nereye para-hitav id end id |
arikeya nâḷ-gauḍan enipa Lôka-Gauṇḍam ||
va || â-mahâ-prabhuvina satiya śīla-guṇav ent endaḍe ||
ka || Toṭṭûra Goyḍa-Gavuḍana |
heṭṭa-magaḷ Kâlikabbe-Gâvuṇḍi jagam |
biṭṭarise sakaḷa-śīla-gu- |
nôṭṭame negaḷd-Attimabbeyam gelevandaḷ ||
â-Kâlikabbe-Gavuḍi ka- |
ḷâ-kuśale Jinêndra-dharmma-nirmmaḷe satatam |
Lôka-Gauṇḍana kula-vadhu |
lôka-prakhyâte Siteyant esedippaḷ ||
svasti śrīmat-Kaḷaturyya-chakravartti râya-Murâri bhuja-baḷa-malla Sôyi-Dêva-varishada nâlkeneya
Vikrita-samvatsarada Panti-śuddha-punṇa-Sômavârav-uttarâyaṇa-saṅkramâṇa-punya-dinadoḷu
Tevarateppaḍa Lôka-Gâvuṇḍam tanna mîdisida Ratnatraya-dêvara ashta-vidhârchchanakkam
banda hôḍa risiyar-âhâra-dânakkam śrîmanu-mahâ-maṇḍalâchâryyar appa Bhânukîrtti-saiddhântika-
dêvargge kâḷam karchchi dhârâ-pûrvvakam mâḍi koṭṭa gadde (here follow details of gift and usual
final phrases) â-mahâ-prabhuvina piriya-gurugaḷ appa Munichandra-dêvara tapa-prabhâvam
ent endaḍe ||
vṛitta || mantanam êm samasta-paramâgamadoḷ paḍa-śâstradoḷ pramâ- |
ṇântaraḍoḷ samasta-gaṇitaṅgaḷoḷ orvvane taḍjûan âgi chai- |
rantana-mârggadim naḍadu viśva-nutam Munichandra-dêva-sai- |
ddhântika-chakravartti jasamaṃ desey-antu-varaṃ nimirchchidam ||

endaḍe ||

pesarvett ugra-samagra-dēvateyarum tam-tamma pīṭhāgradim |
pesar gēḷal birut ōḍipōgi irppar kkaran yakṣa-rā- |
kṣhasa-gandharvva-piśācha-bhūta-phaṇi-vēṭāḷādi-tībra-graham |
besan ēn embuyu Bhânukīrtti-munipājñā-śakti sāmānyam em ||
uragōgra-graha-śākini-vihaga-bhūta-prēta-raṇṭṭaṅga-bhēn- |
tara-paisācha-niśācharādbhūta-gaṇam bhū-chakraḍoḷ tōral u- |
ddharisitt ant ade yantra ōḍidude mantram koṭṭa bēr tantrav a- |
chchhari saiddhānta-Bhânukīrtti-munināthōgrājñē sāmānyamē ||
śrīman-Mūla-padādi-saṅgha-ṭilakē śrī-Kuṇḍakundanvayē |
Kāṇūr-nnāma-gaṇōtsa-gatsa-śubhagē bhū-Tintriṇīkāhvayē |
śiṣyaḥ śrī-Munichandra-dēva-yaminaḥ saiddhānta-pāraṅgamō |
jiyād Baṇḍaṇikā-purēśvaratayā śrī-Bhânukīrttir munīḥ ||

Dundubhi-saṃvatsarada Māgha-śuddha 5 lu śrīmat-Keḷadi-Basavappa-Nāyakaru Liṅgage barasi
kaḷuhida kāryya Kupaṭūra sīme Āṇevaṭṭi-grāmadalu hostāgi kaṭṭuva pēṭeyallu Hañchina
Siddabasavappa-Voḍērige Puṭṭatanavara bhaktiyalu kallu-maṭhava kaṭṭisikoṇḍu sēveya krayava
koḍevu yi-maṭhada hitalu kopalu bage yi-pēṭhē-samīpada Kārehoṇḷada kōḍiyallu prāku nillisida
nashtada bhūmiyāda 3½ yi-grāmadalu haḷe-pēṭheyalu prāku yidda hūgopala staḷake terigey illa yi-
staḷakke sistu-māḍi yi-staḷana hāluttāra koḍabēk endu Garajina Virapa-Voḍēru hēḷikoḷuthārē ālisi
appaṇe āgabēk endu Gurapanavaru hēḷikoṇḍa sammandha Yirapa-Voḍēra kaiyya kraya ga 5 aidu-
varahanu aramaṇege tegadukoṇ 1½ Kupaṭūra-sīme Āṇevaṭṭi-grāmadala hostāgi kaṭṭuva pēṭhe-
samīpadalu Kārehoṇḍada kōḍiyalu prāku nillisinda nashtavinda maṭha kaṭṭisi hatalu kopalu bage saha 3½
yi-grāmada haḷe-pēṭheyalu yida pūgappallige yiga māḍida sistu 1½ ubhayam ga ½ ondu-honnanu yi-
staḷa lalu Puṭatanavara bhaktiyalu yi-Virapa-Voḍeyaru Hañchina Siddabasapodērige kaṭsisikoḍuva
svatantra-mathada dharmmake Sivārppitav āgi uttāra koṭṭu yi-bhūmige liṅga-mudrā-śilā-stāpitava
māḍisuvallige hujūriada ůligada Muḍiyana kaḷuhisidēve chau-grāmadavara karasikoṇḍu gaḍi-takaraṟu
bāradante yalana mundiṭṭu rēkhē-pramāṇu bhūmige śilā-stāpitava māḍisikoṭṭi yi-kāgadava śanabō-
vana kaḍitakke barasi tirigi koḍuvadāgi (No more writing).

Trētā-Dvāpara-pāramārtha-vibhavāḥ pṛthvīm abhuñjanu imām ||
kālē Kaḷau kalushaṭām upayāti lōkē
dharmō nirīkshya nija-sañcharaṇa-kshamatvam |
srashtuḥ samasta-jagatām upakartur ārya-
pārēvaṃ jagāma tasmai kṛipaṇam kṛipaḷuḥ ||
pādēnaikēna lōkē katham iva Kaḷinā klēśitas sañcharēyam
kiñchan nātha prasīda praṇata-jana-vipadd-hāra-vistāra-bandhō |
ittham dharmēṇa tātaḥ su-chiram anunaya-prārthitā prīta-chittaḥ
chakrē S'ailaṅkanāthē mahati nṛipa-kulē Saṅgamākhyam mahīpam ||
dharmālambasya tasya prakaṭita-yaśasaḥ Saṅgama-kshōṇibhartuḥ
patnyām Kāmāmbikāyām ajanishata śitā dik-pati-prāpta-satvāḥ |

ēvaṁ tē nāmadbēyāḥ Harihara-nṛpatiḥ S'aṅkara-kṣhōṇipālō
vīra-śrī-Bukka-bhūpaḥ sakala-guṇa-nidhiḥ Mārapaḥ puṇya-śīlaḥ ||
Harēr bāhu-stambhā iva bhuvana-rakṣhā-praṇayinaḥ
dviśat-samhartāraḥ *Surapati-Gajēndrāśra-vadanāḥ |
jagat-sraṣhṭur vēdā iva sakala-dharmārtha-nilayāḥ
kumārāś catvārō babhur atikālās Saṅgama-vibhōḥ ||
ēṣhām gōtrādbidāivaḥ sakala-sura-guruḥ śrī-Virūpākṣha-dēvaḥ
puṇya sat-Tuṅgabhadrā-sarid Amaradhunī-sammitōdyāna-kulyā |
gēham jāyā-vitānaṁ viharaṇa-śikhari Hēmakūṭāchalābhā
kṛiḍā-vāpīva Pampā-sara iti mahatī sampad ēṣhā vibhāti ||
vīra-vikrama-kathaika-sākṣhiṇī Hastinīti nagarī garīyasā |
pālitā Hariharēṇa bhūbhujā bhrātṛibhir vigata-matsarāḥ samam ||
Kallāsanān Mārapa-bhūmipālaḥ samprāpya rājyaṁ diśi paśchimāyāṁ |
Gōmanta-śailē vara-Chandraguptau sthitvā sukham samyag apālayat prajāḥ ||
yad-yaśas-sita-karpūra-mōda āmbōdayan divam |
mandāra-surabhi-vyāptām spardhatē vardhitaujāsa ||
rājādhirājas tējasvī yuvarāt paramēśvaraḥ |
Bhōja-Tailaṅga-bhūpāla-bhujāṅga-vihagōnnataḥ ||
rājādham trayāṇām pratyaṅkaḥ para-rāja-bhayaṅkaraḥ |
Hariṇā cha samas tṛiṇbē bandi-vargēṇa varṇyatē ||
yasmin mahipē satī vīra-Mārapē
dharmō vyavardhiṣhṭa su-bhṛiṣhta-vartmani |
iti prapālyātisu-bhṛiṣhta-hṛid yayau
kṣhēmam janānām abhikāṅkṣhayā prabhuḥ ||
kurvan dig-vijayam kadāchid stambērama-prōjvalad-
vāhā-vyūha-bhaṭāvaḷi-pihita-dik-chakraṁ cha S'akrōpamam |
Kādamba-kṣhitipam vijitya samarē Gōkarṇa-nātham S'ivam
draṣhṭum viṣhṭapa-mūla-kāraṇam athō prāyād anāyāsataḥ ||
snātvā parvaṇi sāgarāmbhasi pitṛin santarpya viprān api
kṣhōṇī-gō-mahiṣhi-hiraṇya-nichayair bhūri-pradō Mārapaḥ |
śrigandhāgaru-kuṅkumair aviraḷaiḥ svarṇa-prasūnāir mudā ||
sahasrē cha śata-dvandvē śaṭṣhu chaṣhṭāśu cha kramāt |
S'aka-varṣhē prasiddhē cha vartamānē Vyayābḍakē ||
Māghē dars'ērkavārē S'atabhishajai ravau Kumbhagē sidda-yōgē
nāgē sūryōparāgē nirupama-sukṛiti sannidhau tasya S'ombhōḥ |
viprēbhyas svāśritēbhyaḥ sakala-nigamavidbhyō'ndhra-dēśāgatēbhyaḥ
prādād dhārā-samētām draviṇa-bahu-yutām Kāntapūrīm samastām ||
ṣhaṭ-karma-prathitaḥ ṣhaḍaṅga-niraṭāḥ ṣhaṭ-karma-vaijñānikāḥ
ṣhaḍjādi-svara-bhāvukāś cha *ṣhaḍabhijñātvrātmanōtsēdhakāḥ |
ṣhaḍ-bhāṣhā-chaturāḥ ṣhaḍ-adhva-niraṭāḥ ṣhaḍ-vairi-garvāpahāḥ
ṣhaṭ-varṇanuparāḥ ṣhaḍ-ūrmi-niraṭāḥ svātmānubōdhōdyamāḥ ||
ākhyāna-smṛiti-kāvya-nāṭaka-kathālaṅkāra-pāraṅgatāḥ
nitijñā nikhilāgama-sthiti-vidaḥ satya-vratā dhārmikāḥ |
āpannārtti-haraḥ kṛipā-para-vaśā lōkōpakara-kriyā-
prādurbhūta-guṇāś cha Mārapa-purē mānyā vadānyā dvijāḥ ||

*So in the original.

Sorab Taluq. 137

êṣhāṃ gōtra-nāmāni vṛtti-kalpanā cha (here follow details).

ēvaṃ niśchitya tatraiva aṣhṭāviṃśati-saṅkhyakāḥ |
Chandragutti-puraṃ prāpya sukham āstē mahā-yaśāḥ ||
dharmēṇa tasya paripālayatā prajānāṃ
rājñō’dhirājya-gahanāmbu-dhāri-karṇadhāraḥ |
prajñā-balēna Gurum apy atisandadhānāḥ
mantri mahān ajani Mādhavā-nāmadhēyaḥ ||
Kriyāśakti-gurus sākṣhāt tējasā śrī-Triyambakaḥ |
parañjayasya samprāptō Bhārgavasyēva Śaṅkaraḥ ||
trayīṃ samālōkya purāṇa-saṃhitā
hitāya lōkasya priyāya mantriṇaḥ |
puṃsāṃ dadau Tryambaka-śāsanōkta-
samasta-S’aivāgama-sāra-saṅgrahah ||
ākārayan Mādhava-dhīś cha śāsanaṃ
sva-lōka-rāja-dvija-dharma-śāsanaṃ |
sva-dēśa-mukhya-prathubhir mahājanaiḥ
sad-agrahārair dvija-puṅgavaiś cha ||

Kuntala-dēśa-maṇḍanāyamāna-Vānavāsi-dvādaśa-sahasra-saṅkhyāka-rājya-pradhāna-rājadhāni-Chan-
dragutti-para-nāmadhēya-Gōmanta-parvata-dvādaśa-kharvāṭa-madhya-dēśa-vilasad-Yaḍanāḍa-Nāga-
rakhaṇḍe Kamaṭha-purāntargata-Varadā-nadi-tirastha-Kāntapurī-pratināma-Vīra-Mārapapurīṃ bhū-
pati-nāma ā-chandrārkkaṃ sva-pālana-siddhayō sahiranyōdaka-pūrvakaṃ śrī-Kṛiṣhṇārpaṇa-pūrvakaṃ
gaḷyamba aṣhṭa-bhōga-tējas-svamyādi-sarva-samasyam sarvamānyam dattavantaḥ | tasya sīmā yathā |
(here follow details of boundaries) (.. rāyara paḍaṇḍe Rāvappa)† sākṣiṇāḥ |
āditya-chandrāv anilō’nalaś cha &c. ||
ēkaiva bhaginī &c. ||
natvā natvā yāchatē Mārapēndrō
vāraṃ vāraṃ bhāvinaḥ kṣhōṇipālān |
sāmānyō’yaṃ dharma-sētur nṛipāṇāṃ
varṣē varṣē rakṣhaṇīyō bhavadbhiḥ ||
śrī-Virūpākṣha sākshi śrī-Yaḍanāḍa-Madhukēśvara sākshi ||

cells.text_roman: svasti śrīmatu Vijaya-saṃscharada Vaisāka svasti śrī vijayābhyudaya-S'ālivāhana-śaka-varuśa 1455 neya Vijaya-saṃvatsara-Vaisākha-suddha 10 S'anivāradalu śrīmatu mahārājādhirāja rāja-para-mēśvara śri-vira-Achyuta-Rāya-mahārāyaru sukha-rājyaṃ geyyutt irppalli Channappaṇṇanayanavara (a)santānav āda Allappa-Nāyakaru Huruḷiya Hanumanta-dēvarige koṭṭa dharmma-śāsana-kramav ent endare Achyuta-Rāya-mahārāyara kāryyake karttar āda Iiriya-Tirumala-Rājayyanavarige anēka-dharmmav āgabēk endu Achyuta-Rāya-mahārāyaru tamage amaramahaley āgi pālisida Chandraguṭṭiya durgakke saluva Ghaṭṭē-sajaḍa Huruḷiya grāmakke saluva Koppakke pratināmav āda Timmāpurada grāmakke saluva chatus-simeyoḷaḍa gadde beddaḷu tōṭa ṭuḍike kumari kāḍaramba sakala-suvarṇādāya sakala-bhaṭṭādāyavanu āgumāḍikoṇḍu akṣhiṇi-āgāmi-jala-pāṣhāṇa-nidhi-nikṣhēpa-siddha-sādhyṅgaḷ amba aṣhṭa-bhōga-tējas-svāmyavanu āgumāḍikoṇḍu Huraḷiya Hanumanta-dēvara amṛita-paḍi-nandādīpti-naivēdya sthānika hasaṭu tammuṭukāṛarige sandu Tirumala-Rāja-ayyanavarige darmmav āgabēk endu Huraḷiya Hanumanta-dēvarige biṭṭa Huraḷiya-grāmakke saluva Koppakke pratināmav āda Timmāpuravanu sarvvamānyav āgi biṭṭukoṭṭu ā-chandrārkka salu .... du endu koṭṭa dharma-śāsana (usual final verses and phrases).

cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.text_roman:
svasti śrī pritvi-vallabham mahārājādhirāja rāja-paramēśvaram parama-bhaṭṭārakam Satyāśraya-kuḷa-tiḷakam Chālukyābharaṇam śrīmatu Sōmēśva[ra] rājyam geyye 13 ne Kāḷayukti-samvatsara-Phālguṇa-ba-5 Ā svasti śrīman-mahā-maṇḍalēśva[ram] Hossaḷa-Dē[va] Gaṅgavāḍi-Noḷambavāḍi-Taḷakāḍu-Kāñchey-Uchchhaṅgi-Banavāse-pannirchhās rada ko . . Hānuṅgaḷu . . . . . . mutti iralu Nāgarakaṇḍam-erppattakkam Sōmarasam nārgaṇḍu geyye Uiriya-Māguṇḍige Bamma-Gāvuṇḍa Doḍḍa-Gāvuṇḍa ūrgāvuṇḍu geyye svasti śrīman-mahā-maṇḍalēśvaram Banavāse-pura-varādhīśvara Jayanti-Madhukēśvara-Dēva-labdha-vara-prasādi Madhukarasana besadim Jakki-Seṭṭi Hiriya-Māguṇḍiya irivalli Babbi-Seṭṭiya maga Bommaṇam tuṛu hariye peṇḍir-uḍey urchuvaḷi surig iṛidu meṛedu sura-lōka-prāptan āda
jitēna labhyatē &c. ||

Sorab Taluq 149

svasti samasta-praśathi-sahitaṃ śrīman-mahā-maṇḍaleśvaram Kīrtti-Dēvara piriya-paḍavaḷa Kīrttiyaṇṇaṅgaḷu S’aka-varsha-mūvatta-nālkeneya Nandana-samvatsarada Śrāheyalu Hayveya-kappamaṃ taralu pōḍalli paḍavaḷa-Kīrttiyaṇṇana mayduna Biñjimayyaṅga maga Dēmaṇṇaṃ bayala bavaradaḷu mārbbalamaṃ neraḍ aḷam maṇad iḍu sura-lōka-prāptaṃ āḍa || ātana taṅge paḍavaḷa-Kīrttiyaṇṇana paḍavaḷiti Chaṭṭikabbeyum ātana maga Uḍḍahareya Mārāśiṅgayana heṇḍati Hellabbe Yidada-kereyaṃ kaṭṭisi parōksha-vineyaṅgalam māḍi bīra-gūḷ etti kalla nirisidaḷu ||
jitēna labhyate &c. ||
virāvatāran ahitara | bēram nir-mmūḷam arppā vajra-kuṭhāram ||
Bhārata-purushara ka’.. śam | dhāraṇiyoḷ su-bhaṭa-ratna Biñjaṇa-Dēma ||
paḍavaḷa-Kīrtti ... ydunan | edāruva-vairigaḷ aḷadu seleyalu hoydam ||
kaḍu .... jana-Dēmam | paḍe mechchaluk ... iṛidu dēva-lōkake saṇḍa ||
sēnabōva .... yaṃ barada | Masaṇōjana tamma Māmāli besam geydo ||

(I) svasti S'aka-bhûpâḷa-kâḷakrânta-saṃvatsara-śataṅgaḷ eṇṭu-nûr-eḷpaṭṭâraṇeya Ânanda-saṃvatsaram pravartsise svasti Akâḷavarsha-Dêva śri-prithivi-vallabha mahârâjâdhirâja paramêśvara paramabhaṭṭârakam Kannara-Dêva râyam geyyutt ire samadhigata-pañcha-mahâ-śabda mahâ-sâmantâdhipati Trikunda-pura-varêśvaram Brahma-Kshatriyam Mâṭûra-vaṃśôdbhavan akaḷaûka-niran Nandana-vana-chchhatra-haya-lâñchanam darppana-dhvaja-virâjamâṇam śauryya-Dilipa sogas-ugaḍ-âṇmam dhâraṇe-vedeṅgam viśishṭa-jana-mitram vijayâgaram (II) śrimad-Mâchiy-arasar Ede-nâḍoḷ iḷdu pannirchchhasirakkam arasu-geyyutt ire Kukkaraseya maṇṇigam birada Vôjigaṃ samasta-bhara-nirḍpitan âgi perggaḍetanam geyyuttam Kâṛttika-bahuḷa-pañchami-vâradandu Muṭṭa-guppeyam mahâjanakke koṭṭu mûvattirchchhasiram ond arasu-geye halam iḷdam tamm-ajjam Magusi Mâkalana dêguḷakke Mudi .. maḷ gaṭṭisida ker-ya keḷage irmmattar-kkeyyam dêvargge biṭṭam

(III) pati-hitamam mnamam goḷe nṛpam nṛpa-karyya-vichâraḍoḷ Bṛihas- |
patiy ene dhâra-dharmmada negaḷteya śauchada pempiṇoḷ guṇa- |
pratati ... guṇaṅgaḷ ene biḷdir avar sale kûḍidalli bi- |
chchhatan ene kirtti parvire dhara-taḷadoḷ negḷḍ âṭan Ojigam ||
sênabôva Nâkayyan baraḍom maṅgaḷam

svasti samasta-bhuvana-prasasta-Saka-bhūpāḷa-kāḷākrā . . . . vatsara-śataṅgaḷ eṇṭu-nūr-aṟuvatt-
ondaneya Vikāri . . . . . . . sti pṛithvī-vallabha mahārājādhirāja . . . . . . . . bhaṭṭārakam Kannara-
Dêva rājyaṃ geyyu . . . . . . . . . . mahā-śabda mahā-sāmantādhipa . . . . pura-varêśvaraṃ Brahma-
Kshatriyam mMāṭūra-vaṃśôdbhava . . . . . . . niraṇ Nandana-vana chhatra-haya-lāñchhana-darppaṇa-
dhvaja-vi . . . māna śauryya-Dilīpaṃ sogas-ugad āṇmam guṇa-pakshapā ti chārane-vedeṅgaṃ viśishṭa-
jana-mitraṃ vijayāgaraṃ śrīmat-Māchigaṃ He.. siyoḷ sukha-saṅkathā-vinôdaṅgaḷin arasu-geyyutt
ildu S'rīkaṇṭha-paramêśvara-charaṇa-kamala-bhaktiyim dharmmānurakta-chittadiṃ Brahmabhôjaṅga-
parama-svāmigaḷa pāda-prakshāḷana-pūrvvakadiṃ śrī-Mārā.. na dêgulakke vairāgya-sthānam āgire
biṭṭa vṛittiya dharmma-kramav āvud endade kôṭeyim teṅkaṇa Kallare-bayal-vola-ge taḷa-vṛitti vondu
. . . . -kôṭeya munde nivêdyakke sejje-gadde ondu mattalu bāḍa . . . . . . hallivû Eḍe-nāḍ-erpaṭtarga
baḷiya bāḍa Kūluga-Nembūru S'rīkaṇṭhêśvara-dêvara aṅga-bhôgaka raṅga-bhôgaka Chaitra-pavitrakka
tapôdhanar-āhāra-dānakka kaṇḍarputita-jīrṇṇôddhāra-nimittam āge kaṭakada-gôva Baṇavāseya
Chaṭṭaya-Dêvanu Māṭūra-vaṃśôdbhavam Māchi-Dêvan . . d irddu uttarāyaṇada saṅkrānti-byatipāta-
Sômavāradandu ubheya-sāmya sarvva-namasyam āgire svasti yama-niyama(ya)-svādhyāya-dhyāna-
dhāraṇa-maunānushṭhāna-japa-samādhi-śīḷa-guṇa-sampannar appa śrīmatu Rudraśakti-Paṇḍita-
dêvara kālaṃ karchchi dhārā-pūrvvakam māḍi biṭṭa dharmma (usual final phrases and verses).

*yasya . . tta sīma-kshêtraṃ rakshayê[t] kaśchid êva tam |
pūrvva- . . . . . . guṇa . . . . . . . . . bhavati tê nara ||
tiḷārddhārddha-pramāṇêna (yô mām) nirmmālyaṃ bhakshayên naraḥ |
śvāna-yôni-śataṃ gatvā chāṇḍalam abhijāyatê ||
sva-dattāṃ para-dattāṃ vā &c. ||

svasti śrī pṛthvi-vallabham mahārājādhirājam paramēśvaram parama-bhaṭṭārakam Yādava-Nārā-yaṇam śrīmatu vīra-Baḷḷāḷa-Dēva-varsha *11 Piṅgaḷa-saṃvatsarada Aśvayuja-su-tadige-Sōmavāra-vitipāta-saṅkramana śrīmanu mahā-pradhānam Kēdāra-dēvara divya-śrī-pādārādhakanam app Arasiyakereya Mahādēva-daṇṇāyakam rājyam geyyuttire ātana pratāpav ent endaḍe ||
toḍard-arige Māri taṇṇoḷu | biḍe seṇasuvavage Mṛtyu raṇa-raṅgadoḷam |
tadavadipa sidilu vairige | gaḍa nam .. y-Arasikereya Mahādēva-nṛpam ||
saraṇ enalu kāvan itam | raṇa-raṅgadoḷ antavarge Java-rājan ivam |
pirid-iv-eḍeyol Karṇṇam | sariy āru Mahādēva-daṇṇāthaṅg igaḷ ||
pati-kāryyad-eḍage Garuḍam | Kratuharaṇam pūjiteyoḷ ati-dṛḍhan itam |
pitan iva-kāva-guṇadoḷ | Pitripati raṇa-raṅgadoḷ Mahādēva-nṛpam ||
Mahādēva-daṇṇāyakana suṅkada-heggaḍe Mādirāja Chiṭṭūra śrī-Rāmanātha-dēvara nandā-dīvigege Hettena vokalu-dere-sahita mūle-suṅka eraḍu gāṇadere eraḍu huḍuva-tere yinituvam (stops here).

166 Sorab Taluq.

Footnote
1. *So in the original.

gōḍagey endu..mmaṇḍana gaḷe .. yan (imprecatory phrases).

.. ddha-Rāmanātha saraṇu... paramēśvara para.... rbi parvviy aḍaṅgi koṃ... n orbaṇṇigey
āgi yōgi ... naḍa koueya jōtiśvananam.... rūpāgi yajamānanum..... nun tāneyagi yōgā ....
nnakhaleyaṅgaḷ ellavam sampā.... ga-ramaṇiya-kṣētravane sthaḷadi .... khe viḍidu abhinava-S'rī-
śailava... di Kapila-Siddha-Mallikārjjuna-dē.. sinindu puṇya-pāpaṅga.... peḷḍu besam peḷuttam iralu
... sam dēvā yaṇalu || yi-sthā.. ūrugaḷam bhūmigalam.. ḷam yi-liṅgakke hastōdakam mā... manam
bēsade karadu koṃ...nemb ātana | ātana-(mātā)mātṛ-pitṛgaḷ ellamam yeppatta-ēḷu-kōṭi-varuśam..
.. sam pulaṅgoḍantha narakadoḷag ikki | inn āhuṭigoluttiru | gaṇḍā eḷe pāpave | Yi-Mahādēvana
bhūmi-danakke | ā.. añjuvenendu pauḍeyam pāv aḍarddante manam beḍari poḍavaṭṭu.. .. bēgam
si.. koṇḍu bā kaṇḍa yele puṇyave Kavilāsakke | yint eraḍara .. ge puṇya-pāpaṅgaḷu pārḍdu koṇḍ-
oyvudu | tappadu diṭa diṭam satyam gaṇḍre yembudu śrī-Siddha-Rāmanāthana śrī-vachana ||
svasti samasta-praśasti-sahitam | śrīmanu-mahā-maṇḍalēśvaram | sāhitya-ratunākaram | saraṇā-
gata-vajra-pañjaram | vairi-pannaga-Vainatēyanum | Maleya-maṇḍalika-vibhrāḍanum | Malaparoḷu
gaṇḍanum | gaṇḍabhēruṇḍanum | kadana-prachaṇḍanum | maleva-maṇḍalika-kōḷāhaḷanum |
uḍḍaṇḍa-maṇḍalika-kālāḷanum | subhaṭa śikhāmaṇi | āśṛita-jana-chintāmaṇi | vairi-gharaṭṭa |
duṣṭa-maṇḍalika-diśāpaṭṭa | sāhitya-jana-hṛit-sarōjani-virājita-rājabamsa | ari-maṇḍalika-baḷa-vidh-
vamsa | hayārūḍhādhika-Sāḷihōtra-rēkhā-rēvanta | para-baḷa-kṛitānta | jayāṅgaṇā-kānta | śrīmatu-
Billēśvara-dēvara śrī-pāda-paṅkaja-bhramaran enisida Bīrarasara vijaya-rājyam uttarōttarābhivṛiddhi
Saka-varuśa 1178 neya Naḷa-saṃvatsarada Chaitra-ba-30 Sōmavāra-viti-parvvadalu śrīmatu dakṣi-
ṇa-Vāraṇāsi | abhinava-S'risailav enippa śrī-Sonnaligeya-purada Kapila-Siddha-Mallikārjjuna-
dēvara | aṅga-bhōga-raṅga-bhōga-khaṇḍa-sphuṭita-jirṇnōdhāra | nitya-hōma | annā .. tsatrakke |
tamma Jiḍuvaḷige nāḍoḷagana Kōḷisāḷeya | pūrvva-sīme | chatur-aghāṭadoḷagana jala-pāṣāṇa-nidhi-
nidhāna-nikhēpa-sahita | sarvva-bōdhe-parihārav āgi dhārā-pūrvvakam māḍi koṭṭa dharmma
chandrārkka-tāra-bara saluttam iralu maṅgaḷa mahā śrī

Caḷukyānāṃ kulam alaṅkarishṇōr aśvamēdhāvabhṛi[t]ha-snāna-pavitrikṛita-gātrasya śrī-Pulakēśi-
vallabha-mahārājasya sūnuḥ parākramākrānta... asyādi-para-nṛipati-maṇḍala-prapavaddhā-viśuddha-
kīrttiḥ śrī-Kirttivarmmā pṛithuvi-vallabha-mahārājas tasyātmajas samara-samsakta-sakalōttarā-
pathēśvara-śrī-Harṣhavarddhana-parājayōpalabdha-Paramēśvarāpara-nāmadhēya-Vikramāditya-para-
mēśvara-bhaṭṭārakasya mati-sahāya-sāhasa-mātra-samadhigata-nija-vaṃśa-samuchita-chita-rājya-
vibhavasya vividha-rasita-sita-samara-mukha-gata-ripu-narapati-vijaya-samupalabdha-kīrtti-patākāya-
bhāsita-dig-antarasya himakara-kara-vimala-kula-paribhava-vibhava-hētu-Pallavapati-parājayānantara-
parigṛihīta-Kāñchī-purasya prabhāva-kulīśa-daḷita-(IIa)Chōḷa-Pāṇḍya-Kēraḷa-dharaṇīdhara-stūyamā-
na-māna-śṛiṅgasya ananya-samavanata-Trairājya-Pallava-valam avashṭabhya samasta-
kamaḷasya tri-samudra-madhya-vartti-bhuvana-maṇḍaḷādhīśvarasya sūnuḥ ājñayā Bālēndu-
śēkharasyēva Sēṇānīr ddaitaya-valam atisamuddhata-Trairājya-Pallava-valam avashṭabhya samasta-
vishaya-prasamanād vihita-tan-mauṇurañjanaḥ atyanta-vatsalatvāt Yudhishṭhara iva S'rī-rāmatvād
Vāsudēva iva nṛipānkuśatvāt Paraśu-rāma iva rājāśrayatvād Bharata iva Vinayāditya-Satyāśraya-
śrī-pṛithivī-vallabha-mahārājādhirāja-paramēśvaras varvvān ēva ājñāpayati viditam astu vō’
asmābhir chaturddaśōttara-śat-chhatēshu S'aka-varshēshv atitēshu pravarddhamāna-vijaya-rāya-
saṃvatsarē ēkādaśē varttamānē Toramara-vishayē Chitrasēdu-grāmam adhivasati vijaya-skandhāvārē
dakshiṇāyānābhimukhē bhagavati bhāskarē Rōhiṇī-nakshatrē Sanaischara-vārē Guṇasāgar-

ಸೊರಬ ಹೋಬಳಿ. ನೂನಳ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಕಲ್ಲೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಪೂರ್ವದ ೪ ನೇ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಪೂರ್ವದ ಜಾಗಗಳ ಹತ್ತಿರ.
1 ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಸ್ಭುವಿನವಲಭೂಪಹಾರಾಜಃಧಿರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಭಟ್ಟಾರಕಸತ್ಯಾಗತ್ಯೋಗಮುದ್ರಬಲ್ಲಹ
2 ಸಪ್ತಪುತ್ರರಾಜ್ಯೊದಯವದನಾಗರಸವನಸನ್ನಿಜ್ಞೆಸಿತಮಂಚಕಿಪೊಟ್ಟಿಗಜಿತಗಳ
3 ಸಿಹನಾಗಮಂಮಂಜ್ಞೆಕ್ಲಾಕ್ಯಿಯಿನ್‌ಕಲಿಂವರಾಸನ್‌ಏಕೇಡುಕೋನಸ್ಥುತಿಲೇಕಣು ನಾಲಣ ಜಿಂಗ
4 ಕ್ಯ್ಳಾಸಿಂದುವಸಪುರವುವಿಂದುಕೊಟ್ಟಿಯಂಸಂಖ್ಯ್ಳೆಕೌಕೊಡೇಕೊಣಕ್ಕಿನೆರಕಚಿದ್ಧಾತಸನ್ಯ್ಳೂಯಿತ್ತರ
5 ದ್ವೀತಿಶನವಿದ್ಯೆಲಪ್ಪಿನುಕ್ಕತೆನಾಭಸು ರಾರ್ಜಭ ನಕ್ಷ್ರಣವಿನಸನಕಾಕೆಯುವಕಷ್ಟಿನೃ ವಾಸರೋರಹೇ
6 ಆದನನುಜ್ಯೊಣೊಯುನ್ನು . ಲವನೆಡುಕೋಣ್ತುಗಲೈಸ್ತೃಸ್ಥಾನಿಸ್ತೃಗಲಯುಳೋಳಿವುದನಅವರೂಡಕಡ
7 ಮೂಸ್ತೃತ್ಯೊಣಿನುಳ್ರನಂ . . . . . . . ಅದುಧಮ್ಯ್ಳಸಾಗರಸನಿದವಿತಕಾನಾಸ್ಥಾನಲೆಲ್‌ಪ್ರದಾಸಕಿಯೊಕ್ಕುಳ್ಯುದಕೋಯ್ಯಾ
8 ಟ್ಟಿಗಮನಯುಖಏಡಗಸ . . . . . . . ಜಿಲಪ್ತರ್‌ಕಟ್ಟಿ ನಿದಂ . ರ:ವಳಸನಯುವಾಹನರರೊಟ್ಟುಪಡೆಟ್ಯುಮುಳಿಗಿ
9 ಮುಕೋಚ್ಚೃಣಬಾರಿ . ಟಪ್ಪೃತ್ಯಿದ . . . . . . ನೇತನಿ ದಲನ್ನಿನ ಕೀದಾವಜಮನು ಮುಮಾಲೃಪತಿ . ಸಗರಮನ್ ॥

text.text_original: ಸೊರಬ ಹೋಬಳಿ. ನೂನಳ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಕಲ್ಲೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಪೂರ್ವದ ೪ ನೇ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.ಪೂರ್ವದ ಜಾಗಗಳ ಹತ್ತಿರ.1 ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಸ್ಭುವಿನವಲಭೂಪಹಾರಾಜಃಧಿರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಭಟ್ಟಾರಕಸತ್ಯಾಗತ್ಯೋಗಮುದ್ರಬಲ್ಲಹ2 ಸಪ್ತಪುತ್ರರಾಜ್ಯೊದಯವದನಾಗರಸವನಸನ್ನಿಜ್ಞೆಸಿತಮಂಚಕಿಪೊಟ್ಟಿಗಜಿತಗಳ3 ಸಿಹನಾಗಮಂಮಂಜ್ಞೆಕ್ಲಾಕ್ಯಿಯಿನ್‌ಕಲಿಂವರಾಸನ್‌ಏಕೇಡುಕೋನಸ್ಥುತಿಲೇಕಣು ನಾಲಣ ಜಿಂಗ4 ಕ್ಯ್ಳಾಸಿಂದುವಸಪುರವುವಿಂದುಕೊಟ್ಟಿಯಂಸಂಖ್ಯ್ಳೆಕೌಕೊಡೇಕೊಣಕ್ಕಿನೆರಕಚಿದ್ಧಾತಸನ್ಯ್ಳೂಯಿತ್ತರ5 ದ್ವೀತಿಶನವಿದ್ಯೆಲಪ್ಪಿನುಕ್ಕತೆನಾಭಸು ರಾರ್ಜಭ ನಕ್ಷ್ರಣವಿನಸನಕಾಕೆಯುವಕಷ್ಟಿನೃ ವಾಸರೋರಹೇ6 ಆದನನುಜ್ಯೊಣೊಯುನ್ನು . ಲವನೆಡುಕೋಣ್ತುಗಲೈಸ್ತೃಸ್ಥಾನಿಸ್ತೃಗಲಯುಳೋಳಿವುದನಅವರೂಡಕಡ7 ಮೂಸ್ತೃತ್ಯೊಣಿನುಳ್ರನಂ . . . . . . . ಅದುಧಮ್ಯ್ಳಸಾಗರಸನಿದವಿತಕಾನಾಸ್ಥಾನಲೆಲ್‌ಪ್ರದಾಸಕಿಯೊಕ್ಕುಳ್ಯುದಕೋಯ್ಯಾ8 ಟ್ಟಿಗಮನಯುಖಏಡಗಸ . . . . . . . ಜಿಲಪ್ತರ್‌ಕಟ್ಟಿ ನಿದಂ . ರ:ವಳಸನಯುವಾಹನರರೊಟ್ಟುಪಡೆಟ್ಯುಮುಳಿಗಿ9 ಮುಕೋಚ್ಚೃಣಬಾರಿ . ಟಪ್ಪೃತ್ಯಿದ . . . . . . ನೇತನಿ ದಲನ್ನಿನ ಕೀದಾವಜಮನು ಮುಮಾಲೃಪತಿ . ಸಗರಮನ್ ॥

cells.remarks: Obeisances to S'ambhu, his lofty head kissed by the châmara-like crescent moon, the original foundation pillar of the city of the three worlds. Be it well. (On the date specified), when the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara Ekkalarasa-Dêva was ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :—The nâḷ-prabhu of Mâyile in the Jiḍḍulige Seventy of the Bana-vâse Twelve Thousand, Echa-Gauṇḍa's son Châuḍa-Gauṇḍa,—when the mahâ-maṇḍalêśvara Siṅgi-Dêvarasa came and attacked Mâyile and carried off the cows,—recovered the cows and gained the world of gods. Verses in his praise. Final verse as in No. 1. The âchâri Malôja made this vîragal.

ಅದೇ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೇ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 6′ × 3′.

[1]ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಮತುಸಕವರ್ಷ ೧೧೪೪ ನೇಯ್ಯ ಪ್ರಜೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ಸಂವತ್ಸರದ ಭಾದ್ರಪದ ಸುಧಪಂಚಮಿ ಬುಧವಾರದವರೆಸುರೋಕ್
ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾ
[2]ದನೂ || ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿ ಶ್ರೀಮತುತುಯುಪಾದವರನಾರಾಯಣರುಂಬಜಳತಪ್ಪ ತಪಸಕೃತಿ ಶ್ರೀಸ್ತ್ರೇಯೋನ್ನವಿರಬಲ್ಲಾಲ ದೇವೇವಾರಾ
[3]ಪ್ಪಸಿದ್ಧಮುತ್ರರೌತ್ತ ರಾಜ್ರೇಜೀಯುತ್ತಾ || ನಮಸ್ತುಂ ಗಸಿರಶೃಂಬಿಚಂದ್ರಚೂಡಾಮಣಿರೇವತ್ತ್ರೈಲೋಕ್ಯನಗರಾರಂಭ
ಮೂಲಸ್ಥಂಭಾಯ
[4]ಕಂಭವೇ || ಗಪ್ಪು ದೆದಲನಲೆವಿಹಾಂಗಬಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದ ಯಂಬೆಂದೊಯೆ ಯದೇವದಣಾತ್ತು ರವಮಗಂಬಲ್ಲ . . . ಲೆಂದ
[5]ಯುನದತಡಮುದ್ದು ಗಳು ಶ್ರೀಗತ್ಸಕುರುರೆಯಾಲುದಳಗಳನೇಯಿ ಭೂಮಿಧಿದ್ದೃಥ್ವೀರ್ಷುರಲುವಾಯಲೆಯು ಟಾವುಡಗಣಿನ
ಮಗ
[6]ತ್ಯ್ವಲ್ಲು ಗಾಪ್ಪಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉದುದುಮುದುಮುಲೋಕ (ಪ್ರ) ಪುಣ್ಯಾನಂ || ಸುಖಪ್ರದಸಗುತ್ತೆತ್ತುರ . . . . . . . . . . . . ದಿವಿಜಿ ರಾತ್ರಿ
[7]ಸೊಂದಳತ್ಯೆಯುಲ್ಲ ಗಾಣ್ಣಡವನುಬujಳಳಕ್ಯ ಉಭಯಗೋಂದಾರಪತ್ತುಗಳೊತ್ತೆಯುಲ್ಲ ಗಿದ್ದಿ . . . . . . . . . . . . ||
[8]ಕೀಜಿಕೇಲಪುತ್ತೆಲಕ್ಷ್ಮೀಮಿತೇತವಾಸಿಮಸಾರಂಗವೇಥ್ವಿದ್ಯ ನ್ಮಿಸಿಕಾಂದ್ಯೇಕಚೀಟಂತರಷರೇಸೇ ||
[9]ಶೂಪಗಡೆಯಾವು ರೋಜೇಜನಮಗನುಸಗೇಜುವಾಗೆದಿಕಳವ ||

text.remarks:
Be it well. (On the date specified), he gained the world of gods.

Be it well. The Yâdava-Nârâyaṇa, the bhujabala-pratâpa-chakravartti Hoysaṇa vira-Balâḷa-Dêva's kingdom, may it be firmly established on all sides and victorious.

Obeisance to S'ambhu, &c.

The meaning in some parts is doubtful.

Sorab Taluq

When he was making his residence in Gavuda, Yereyana-Dannâyaka's son Balla... Chandaya
marched, and laying siege with an army of horse and foot, was beating down,—in Bilivâr, Mâyile
Chavuda-Gauḍa's son Taiyla-Gauḍa, slaying and distinguishing himself, gained the world of gods.
His praises. Final verse as in No. 1.

Kupagede Râmôja's son Masanôja made this stone.

Footnote
1. The meaning in some parts is doubtful. Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin. - Signatur: Ph 10130-8 Reproduktion, Vervielfältigung oder Weitergabe nur mit Genehmigung

cells.remarks: Obeisance to S'ambhu, &c. When Ēcha-Gauḍa's son Chauḍa-Gauḍa was holding the lordship, by his order the good warrior Kâḷiga got to *svargga*. Be it well. In the sun to the lotus the Kalachuri-kula, the bhuja-bala-chakravartti Bijjaṇa- Dēva's 10th year, the year Pârthiva, &c.,—When the mahâ-maṇḍalēśvara Ekkala-Dēvarasa was plundering the kingdom in peace and wisdom :—According to the custom of their class, by means of plundering, Da'saratha-daṇḍanâtha and Kâḷarasa having carried off the cows of Hosavaḷḷi, the good warrior Kâḷiga performed prodigies of valour (described). The flowery car, with shining finial and crystal frame, descended, the heavenly drums sounded, and the celestial nymphs, waving châmaras, bore off the good warrior Kâḷiga and entered Amarâvatî-pura to show him the delights of the Indra- lōka. Thus did the tiger cub born in Mâyile to Honneya-nâyaka and his wife Sômavve, their good son the brave warrior Kâḷiga, attack and slay and gain the world of gods. Saṇtôja made (this stone); and the Brahmans of Hosavaḷḷi made a grant of land. Imprecation.

cells.remarks: Be it well. When Prabhûtavarsha, favourite of earth and fortune, mahârâjâdhirâja param- ēśvara bhaṭṭâraka, Gôvindarasa was ruling the world bounded by the four oceans under the shadow of his sole white umbrella :—And Râjâdityarasa was ruling the Vanavâsi country as far as the ocean :— Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin. - Signatur: Ph 10130-8 Reproduktion, Vervielfältigung oder Weitergabe nur mit Genehmigung Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin. - Signatur: Ph 10130-8 Republikation, Vervielfältigung oder Weitergabe nur mit Genehmigung Sorab Taluq Chitravâhana, ruling the Âluvakhêda Six Thousand, not listening to orders, Kolli-Pallava- Nolamba being angry,—at the bidding of Nolambarâditya, that Kâkarasa arose, and throwing the Perggunji fort into confusion, the brave warriors of both armies eagerly came out, and bow closing with bow, horse with horse, a most exciting battle arose. Seeing Chitravâhana on the right hand fighting as if overpowered, he ordered Kulamudda, saying, "You go and fight on this hand,"— who, accepting it as a favour, closed in, fought, brought down the enemy's pride, put them to head- long flight and defeated that hand. He himself and many others shooting arrows and approaching close, were caught up as in a cage of arrows, and fell as Bhishma fell, without touching the ground. The celestial nymphs came forth to meet him, holding offerings, and bore him away to the world of heroes. The skilful carpenter Vâdapuli made (the stone). The ? bondmen of Parige came to this town and in Âridara by fraud destroyed the strength of four bullocks and made it six bullocks, but unable to stand, fled. After that, for the villager Kulamudda, the king, showing favour, having it ploughed with four bullocks as formerly,¹ measured the rice field and showing favour granted it, along with Kundagesevi Kaliyamma and others (named), and the s'ri-karaṇa. Imprecations.

Be it well. When Prabhûtavarsha, favourite of earth and fortune, mahârâjâdhirâja param-
ēśvara bhaṭṭâraka, Gôvindarasa was ruling the world bounded by the four oceans under the shadow of
his sole white umbrella :—And Râjâdityarasa was ruling the Vanavâsi country as far as the ocean :—

Chitravâhana, ruling the Âluvakhêda Six Thousand, not listening to orders, Kolli-Pallava-
Nolamba being angry,—at the bidding of Nolambarâditya, that Kâkarasa arose, and throwing the
Perggunji fort into confusion, the brave warriors of both armies eagerly came out, and bow closing
with bow, horse with horse, a most exciting battle arose. Seeing Chitravâhana on the right
hand fighting as if overpowered, he ordered Kulamudda, saying, "You go and fight on this hand,"—
who, accepting it as a favour, closed in, fought, brought down the enemy's pride, put them to head-
long flight and defeated that hand. He himself and many others shooting arrows and approaching
close, were caught up as in a cage of arrows, and fell as Bhishma fell, without touching the ground.
The celestial nymphs came forth to meet him, holding offerings, and bore him away to the world of
heroes. The skilful carpenter Vâdapuli made (the stone).

The ? bondmen of Parige came to this town and in Âridara by fraud destroyed the strength
of four bullocks and made it six bullocks, but unable to stand, fled. After that, for the villager
Kulamudda, the king, showing favour, having it ploughed with four bullocks as formerly,¹ measured
the rice field and showing favour granted it, along with Kundagesevi Kaliyamma and others
(named), and the s'ri-karaṇa. Imprecations.

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಕೊಡಕಣಿ ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾರಾಯಣ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನವಿದ್ದ ಸ್ಥಳಕ್ಕೆ ವಾಯುವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಪೂರ್ವದ ಹಳಗೆನ್ನ ದೆಕ್ಷರ. — ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 4^{prime} × 1^{prime} 9^{primeprime}.
^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿವಿನವಾದಿತ್ಯಸತ್ಯಾಶ್ರಯ ಶ್ರೀ
^2ಪ್ರಥಿವಿವಳ್ಳಭಮಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜ
^3ಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಭಟ್ಟರಕಳೌಂಳಕನಿಯು
^4ಮಹಾಪಂಕೇ ಸರ್ವ್ಣ್ಬುಧಪರಿವಾರಭಟ್ಟ್ಟಿ
^5ಆಮು ವ ...... ದೇವಪದವಗಾಣೇಸೋಘ
^6ಆಬಾಚ . ನಾಲ್ಳೆ ನೇಮಗಣವರೆವೆಣಿ
^7ಗಲ್ನೊಪುತ್ರ. ಅಂವಮ ಡಿಬಿಸಿನದಾ
^8ರುನ್ಸೆಅಣಜೂನೂನಲ್ಮ ಮಹಾ
^9ಪಾತಕಸಂಯುಕ್ತಂನಕ್ಷ್ರೀಸಪಲಾರವಂ
^{10}ರಕಬುಲಂಬಿಬೆಲನ್ನುಗೆ ಗೋಟಿಗರುಣಸನ್ನಗೋಜೋ
^{11}ಲಿದುರಾಅಲಿಅಡಿಅೀರಸತಾಕ್ಕಾ ಮೂರಬೀಣಗೋಸಾ
^{12}ಸಿಗನುಮುಜುಕಾಣನ್ನು ಉಲಕಟ್ಟಿಗನಿಸಿಕೆ
^13ಸತಯುಎನೆಬುಇಯನ್ತ ಕಲತಿ. . ಮುನ್ನದ
^14....ಚನ್ದಸ್ಯೊರ್ಯ್ಯಮೂಣ್ಣಆಜಮೋನೇಣ
^15ಫಲ್ಲಮ ಮುಪಾಪಾತಕನಕ್ಕನ್

cells.text_original:
ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಅಗಸೆಬಾಗಿಲಲ್ಲಿ ಕರುಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
ಪೂರ್ವದ ಹಳಗೆನ್ನ ದೆಕ್ಷರ. — ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 6^{prime} × 4^{prime}.
^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಪ್ರಥುವಿವಳ್ಳಭಮಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರವರಮಹಭಟ್ಟ್ತರಕ . . . . .
^2ಪ್ರಿಸ್ರೀಮತ್ರ್ಯುಯಸಿಂಹದೇವವಂಧ್ಯವೀರಜ್ಯೊಂಗೆಯೊಕ್ಕಸ್ತೀರಜಂಬಣಸಿನಗಿಪನ್ನಿ ಕ್ಣ . . . . .
^3ನ್ಯಸಕಳಾತ್ರೆಸನಂವತ್ಸರದೆಸತಗಳೌಂಚ್ಯೆನೂಜಮುಲವತ್ತೆ (ಆಣ್ವರುರಾಕ್ಷ್ . . . . .
^4ನೆದ್ದ್ಯಾಂವೆಷ್ಯಾರ್ಯುರಂಗೆಯೊಜ್ಜಯವ್ಯದೇಚೆನಸಕಲಲನ್ನುಊರನಿಸುದೆಲ್ಲ . . . . .
^5ಬೀಬಚೆಣ್ಣ ಣಾಡ್ಯುಟುಬುವಿನ್ನಿ ಕ್ಕಿ ಪಂಯುಮವಾಕ್ಕೊ ಣನ್ನು ತಾಣ್ಬಾಳ್ಯುಉವಿನಸುರುಲೋಕ . . . . .
^6ಜಿಕೇತನಲಬ್ಭತಲಚ್ಚಿ ಕ್ತಮ್ಮು ತೇಣಾಸಿಪಸುರಾಣಂಗನ್ಹೊಣವಿಧ್ಯಂಸನಿಕಾಯೋಲೀಕಾ . . . . .
^7ಪವರಶೆರಶೆ . || ನಸೆಬೆದಸನವರದರೋಳ ಕ್ಯುಮದಗದರಲ್ಲಿ ಆದುಪುಗೇಳಕೃತ್ಯ
^8ಜೂಡಿನೆಂಭಿಚಿದುತಕವತ್ಸನೆ ಕಣಜಾದನಸದೆಯೆಶಂಗೇಳಿಸಿನುಮಗಳವ
^9ಲ್ಲೀಲ್ವೆ || ಸಮ್ಮುರಳಿಬಿಸಕೋಳತನ್ನಸೃಭಾತದವಿರಿಪಕಶೆಕ್ಕಳೋಕ್ಷ್ಯದ್ಧಿಲಕೋಧಮ್ಯುಸುಪ್ರು
^10ತ್ರಾಕುಲಧಿಪಕ || ಕವಮ್ಯಾರಜ್ಜುನನ್ಗೇಕೊಡಂಗೇಕ್ಯಮ್ಮು ಒಂ ಆಜ್ಜ೯ನೋದ್ಯಾನಮಗಂಜಬೆಚ್ಚೊ
^11ಜಕಲ್ಲಣವಾಣಿಸಿದ || ಇಕೊಳನಂಕಟೀದ ||

text.text_original: ಅದೇ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಅಗಸೆಬಾಗಿಲಲ್ಲಿ ಕರುಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.ಪೂರ್ವದ ಹಳಗೆನ್ನ ದೆಕ್ಷರ. — ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 6^{prime} × 4^{prime}.^1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಪ್ರಥುವಿವಳ್ಳಭಮಹಾರಾಜಾಧಿರಾಜಪರಮೇಶ್ವರವರಮಹಭಟ್ಟ್ತರಕ . . . . .^2ಪ್ರಿಸ್ರೀಮತ್ರ್ಯುಯಸಿಂಹದೇವವಂಧ್ಯವೀರಜ್ಯೊಂಗೆಯೊಕ್ಕಸ್ತೀರಜಂಬಣಸಿನಗಿಪನ್ನಿ ಕ್ಣ . . . . .^3ನ್ಯಸಕಳಾತ್ರೆಸನಂವತ್ಸರದೆಸತಗಳೌಂಚ್ಯೆನೂಜಮುಲವತ್ತೆ (ಆಣ್ವರುರಾಕ್ಷ್ . . . . .^4ನೆದ್ದ್ಯಾಂವೆಷ್ಯಾರ್ಯುರಂಗೆಯೊಜ್ಜಯವ್ಯದೇಚೆನಸಕಲಲನ್ನುಊರನಿಸುದೆಲ್ಲ . . . . .^5ಬೀಬಚೆಣ್ಣ ಣಾಡ್ಯುಟುಬುವಿನ್ನಿ ಕ್ಕಿ ಪಂಯುಮವಾಕ್ಕೊ ಣನ್ನು ತಾಣ್ಬಾಳ್ಯುಉವಿನಸುರುಲೋಕ . . . . .^6ಜಿಕೇತನಲಬ್ಭತಲಚ್ಚಿ ಕ್ತಮ್ಮು ತೇಣಾಸಿಪಸುರಾಣಂಗನ್ಹೊಣವಿಧ್ಯಂಸನಿಕಾಯೋಲೀಕಾ . . . . .^7ಪವರಶೆರಶೆ . || ನಸೆಬೆದಸನವರದರೋಳ ಕ್ಯುಮದಗದರಲ್ಲಿ ಆದುಪುಗೇಳಕೃತ್ಯ^8ಜೂಡಿನೆಂಭಿಚಿದುತಕವತ್ಸನೆ ಕಣಜಾದನಸದೆಯೆಶಂಗೇಳಿಸಿನುಮಗಳವ^9ಲ್ಲೀಲ್ವೆ || ಸಮ್ಮುರಳಿಬಿಸಕೋಳತನ್ನಸೃಭಾತದವಿರಿಪಕಶೆಕ್ಕಳೋಕ್ಷ್ಯದ್ಧಿಲಕೋಧಮ್ಯುಸುಪ್ರು^10ತ್ರಾಕುಲಧಿಪಕ || ಕವಮ್ಯಾರಜ್ಜುನನ್ಗೇಕೊಡಂಗೇಕ್ಯಮ್ಮು ಒಂ ಆಜ್ಜ೯ನೋದ್ಯಾನಮಗಂಜಬೆಚ್ಚೊ^11ಜಕಲ್ಲಣವಾಣಿಸಿದ || ಇಕೊಳನಂಕಟೀದ ||

cells.remarks: Be it well. When, the destroyer of hostile kings, master of the four oceans, vira-Bukkappa- Odeyar was ruling the kingdom :— (on the date specified), in the direction of Bandalike, Sâdôja, carpenter of Koḍakaṇi, was attacked by robbers and killed, and gained the world of gods.

cells.location: On a stone to the north of the same temple. [→ At the same village, on a stone in front of the Sidda-Rāmēśvara temple.]
cells.king: Bommarasa-Dêva
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: Be it well. When, with all titles, the mahâ-manḍalês'vara, worshipper of the feet of the god Billês'vara, hunter of the Koṅkaṇi-Râya, setter up of the Tuḷu-Râya, champion over chiefs who obtain horses by giving money, shears to the group of chiefs, surrender of the three worlds, son of the Chêra king . . . . . 's wife Honnala-Dêvi, destroyer of the Kâdamba-Râya,-Bommarasa-Dêva was in the residence of Hosagunda, ruling the kingdom of the world :— And, a dweller at his lotus feet, Koḍakaṇi Masani-Gauda's son Kirtti-Gauda (with various epithets), son of Mâchala-Dêvi, husband of Keladi, brother of Boppa-Mâdarasa, was on pleasant duty in all the *thânas* of the Koḍakaṇi hill-fort ;—Nigalaṅkamalla Tailarsa's son Kâva-Dêva's min- ister, a second Râhuṭṭa-râya, a Bayirava to opponents, Kalla-verggade, getting angry, marched and came and laid siege to the Koḍakaṇi hill-fort in three circles,—on which Kirtti-Gavuḍa, in order to disperse it, ordered his army to take up their shields and draw their daggers, and advanced in un- shaken order. Seeing the impetuosity of the hostile force in front, with excessive fury, like a male lion on an elephant, he wiped out the long line of foot-soldiers, pounded them to ruin, made the energy of the spearmen fail, and calling up the cavalry, annihilated the whole of Kalla's army, and (on the date specified) gained the world of gods. Verses in praise of his valour. Written by the very learned great poet (*kavindra*) Senkara.

ಅದೇ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೇ ಕಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ.
1ಶ್ರಿಮತುಭುಜಲಸತ್ವಪಮವಂಚಕ . . . ಕಗಳಗಂಗದತ್ರಿಯಬಲ್ಲೆ ಕ್ಯೆರದ್ವೇವರದಿಪ್ಪ್ಯ .
2. ದ್ಯಾ[ರಾ]ಧಕವಿಬೆಲಿಬರರಸಂಮಸ್ತವೀರಕಶುಬುಂದಿಬರಾಂಕುಶಂಗೊಯುತ ಮದ್ರಾಚಿಬಿರ
3. ತಸಾಸನವನೆಮಲವಿಳಸಿಬಿಸಂವತ್ಸರದಮಾಫಸು ೧ ಅಗಲವರದಂದುವಾಣಿಸನಿಕಾಲದ
4. . . . ಹಬ್ಬಿಮರಾಣ್ತಂತರವನಿಕ್ರಿಬರಲ:ಆನಾದನಾಯಕರೆಲ್ಲೊನೆವಜಂಒಂದುಮುಕ್ತಿ ಕಾಮುತ್ತಿ ರಳುಕೊಂದಕಣಿ
5. . ಗಾವನಿನಕಟಮುಬ್ಬೆಟ್ಟಿಯನಸಹನೆಮಂತವೆದಾನೆ ॥ ವಿಶ್ವದೇವದಾನವರಾಜಕನಹನೆದಾನವಾಡಿ
6. . . ಮಲ್ಲಿರಾಜಕತ್ಯ್ಞನಪದಹೋಕ್ಕ್ರದೃಷ್ಟುಕ್ಕಾಳಭಮನ್ಯೂನತೆಬೆಟ್ಟಿಟ್ಟುಯಿನೆಸಿಲುಂದೆಂ ಅನು ಮಲ್ಲ
7. . ?ಕಂದ ॥ ಕಟ್ಟುಳತನದೆವರದಿನಜಟ್ಟುಗಣಾಯಕರೆಳೇಕೀತಾಗಿದದವರನಿಸ್ವತ್ತರಗುಂಜುಡುವನ .
8. ಟ್ಟಿಯು . . . ಮಂಪುರಸಿಜಿಟ್ಟ್ಯಬಿಟ್ಟಿಯಯುನಾಗಳ | ವಿನು | ಕಡುಗಡುಮಿಂದೆಬಂದು . . .
9. ಲೀವನ . . ದೇತಗಲ್ಲೆತಾನವಿತದದೇವೀದಾರಿನಮದೇವದಲಿಭರಚಕ್ಕಳಳಸಕ್ಕಾ ಲಟ್ಟ್ಯನೋಲುಮಡಿ .
10. ಬೆಟ್ಟಿ . . ಕೃಯಿನಪುಷ | ಕಾದಳಿಲದಮಾವಷುತಗಂಡನಪೋಗೆಪೂವ್ಯರಮರಂಗನೆ
11. . . . ಬಿನಿದುಲೋಕಕಮುಂ ॥ ಕಾಸುಗಡೆಹಯರಮೋಜಿನಜಂಬೀಲುರೂಪಮಾದಕಲ್ಲುಮಂಗಳಮಹಾ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರೀ

cells.location: At Manemane (same hobli), on a virakal at the village gate.
cells.king: Jagatuṅga
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: Be it well. When the favourite of earth and fortune, Jagatuṅga was ruling the kingdom of the world :-and Râjâditya-râja-paramêśvara was ruling the Banavâsi Twelve Thousand ;-when Peṇarai besieged and rained Manamane, ...'s son Aṅgara-Siṅga distinguished himself, slew many wrestling warriors, and was borne to Indra's world, being carried through all the paths of the seven Jambu-dvipas and the twelve disks of the sun. His praises. The stone work and writing was by Kundavâsi's son Maramma. Several persons (named) granted land. Imprêcation.

ಅದೇ ಹೋಬಳಿ ಮನೆಮುನೆ ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಅಗಸೆಬಾಗಲಲ್ಲಿ ನೆಟ್ಟ ವೀರಕಲ್ಲು.
ಪೂರ್ವದ ಹಳಗನ್ನಡ ಹಕ್ಷರ.—ಪ್ರಮಾಣ 8' × 3'.
1ಸ್ವಸ್ತಿಶ್ರೀಪ್ರಸ್ತುವಿಶ್ವವಲ್ಲಭಸ್ವರಜಾಪ್ರಸ್ತುವಿಶ್ವವಲ್ಲಭಸ್ಯೆ ತ್ರೈಲೋಕ್ಯರಾಜಾದಿತ್ಯರಜಾ ಪರಮೇಶ್ವರಾ
2 . . . . .ಸಿಪನ್ನಿ ಈಲ್ಯಾಸಿನರನಾಡಳಪೇಣ್ಯಮನವೆನುಮುತಿ ಕೊಳ್ಳಾಲೂರಜಖವಿನೊಳಲೆ . . .
3 . . . . .ನಮಗನಾಗೆ ರಸಿನೆಣ ಪೆಣಿಕಿ. ಕಾಮಂತಕಾ ಕಾಲಉದುಗುಹೊಯೆನುಗಟ್ಟೆ ಕೊಳ್ಳಾಪುಯಿ . . .
4 . . . . .ಹಿತಕೊಲಉಲಮಗನುವಕೃದವಜತ್ತಿ ಛಾಬತ್ಕಾಳಪಲರುಮಂಕೊಣ್ಣುತ್ತನುಕ್ . . .
5ದುತನ್ಯೆಭೂಲೋಪ್ಪಿದಲ್ಲಬರ | ಅನ್ನು ಕೆಳೆರಸಂಸಾಚಿ ತಾನ್ಯವಿಮನುಮಂಣ್ಯ ರವಣ್ಣಣೆಣ ಇದೆ.ಇಳಿಗೀತಿ
6 . . ನಯುಸ್ನಿನೇಭೂಮಣ್ಣ ಲದೇಲೌಗಳವಿಲ್ಲಣ ಮನಣಿಯುತುರಗಮನ್ನಾಬ ರವಣ್ಣಣೆಣ ಇಡೇ.ಈಳಿಗೀತಿ
7 . ನಳಸನುಟಜಯುತ್ತ್ಯದ್ಯಿಪಸೂರ್ಯ್ಯಾಛವಿನಪ್ಪಯನೆ ರಡಹೂಣಳೆಗ್ಲೆಮಾಗೆ ರಣಸಾಜ ಜಕೂಮರಜೆ . . .
8 . ತಿರತನಜ್ಞೆ ನೆಸುತ್ತನನ್ನ ಅನ್ನು ಕೆಗೇಸಿನಿಯುಪೋಡಾತನಣ್ಣ ಸೆಂವದ್ಧೆ ನ್ಮುರ್ಕಾ ಸೀಲವಿರಚಿ . . .

text.remarks:
Be it well. When the favourite of earth and fortune, Jagatuṅga was ruling the kingdom of
the world :-and Râjâditya-râja-paramêśvara was ruling the Banavâsi Twelve Thousand ;-when
Peṇarai besieged and rained Manamane, ...'s son Aṅgara-Siṅga distinguished himself, slew many
wrestling warriors, and was borne to Indra's world, being carried through all the paths of the seven
Jambu-dvipas and the twelve disks of the sun. His praises.

The stone work and writing was by Kundavâsi's son Maramma. Several persons (named)
granted land. Imprêcation.

cells.location: In Soraba, on a pillar of the avabhṛita-maṇṭapa on the eastern bank of the Daṇḍāvati river.
cells.dynasty: Hoysaḷa
cells.king: Ballâḷa-Dêva
cells.language: Kannada and Sanskrit
cells.remarks: Having the supreme profound *syâd-vâda* as a fruit-bearing token, may it prevail, the doctrine of the lord of the three worlds, the Jina-śâsana. In the lotus pond the ocean, like a stalk for the lotus Jambu-dvipa was the golden mountain ; south from which, with ruddy hue, shone the Bharata-kshêtra; an ornament to Bharata was the Kuntaṇa-dêśa; as the chief jewel in which, of distracting brilliance, was the Banavâsa-dêśa. The master of that country and of many other countries surrounded by the ocean :-When, desiring to give this chief place in the world to Saḷa of the Yadu-kula, Sudatta-munipa made Padmâvati appar, -on her coming as a tiger, seeing and recognizing her, he said *poy Sala* (strike, Sala), whereupon he smote it with the munipa's rod *(sele)*, and displaying his courage to the goddess, that king acquired the name Poysaḷa. After Sudattâchâriya had thus obtained from the goddess Padmâvati and bestowed it, in many that line ruled the kingdom in succession. After whom was born the king Ballâḷa; praise of his fame, the streams of whose brilliance washed the collyrium from the eyes of his enemies' wives. When Ballâḷa-Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom in peace and wisdom :- Sorab Taluq. Koḍakaṇi was distinguished as a mine (*kaṇi*) of the gems of learned men and beautiful women in the Rōhaṇa mountain Banavāse. Its ruler, an ornament to the Banavāsa-dēśa, a gāvuṇḍa glory, his pure fame like saffron to the breasts of the ladies the points of the compass,—was Masana. His son, (with praises) was Kirtyi-gāvuṇḍa. His sons were Sōma, Masana, Mahādēva and Rāma. His son-in-law was Mahādēva-daṇḍanātha ; (his praises). To Malla-Seṭṭi and Māchāmbike was born Nēma, whose guru was Gunachandra of the Mūla- saṅgha and Kānūr-gaṇa. Nēmi-Seṭṭi, of the Nunna-vaṁśa, raised up many Jinēndra temples in Jidvalige-nāḍ and Eḍe-nāḍ. And in Koḍakaṇi he caused to be made the S’āntinātha Jinālaya. Thus Nēmi-Seṭṭi (on the date specified^{1}) at the time of setting up the god S’āntinātha, surrounded by Kirtyi-gāvuṇḍa, with his sons and his son-in-law Mahādēva-daṇḍanātha, made a grant of 50 poles of rice-land for the eight kinds of ceremonies of the god, and for the food of the rishis. And S’rīkaṇṭha-bratipa gave to the priest of the S’ānti-Jina temple a suitable abode, which was like a cage of adamant.

ಸೊರಬದಲ್ಲಿ ದಂಡಾಪತೀ ನದಿಯ ಪೂರ್ವದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಹ್ಯತಮಂಟುಪದ ಕಂಠೆದಲ್ಲಿ.
“ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರುಮದ್ರವಮಂಗಭರಸಸ್ಯದೃಧಾವುನರಫೇಲಾಂಭನಂಜಯಾತ್ರೆ) ಳಲೋಕ್ಯ
'ನಾಫನ್ಮ್ಯಕ್ಷಾಸನಂಜಿಜಿನಾಸನಂ ॥ ಅಂಬುಧಿ ಕಮಲಕಕರೆದೊಳ್ ಒಂಬ್ವೀಲ್ಪಾ
'ಪ್ಪ ದೋಂದುಕಕಣ್ಣಿ ೯ ಕೆಯಿನಿಕುಂಫ್ಣಜಟ್ಟದಟೀಲಿತೆಂತಕುಟೊಜತ್ತೆ ಸರ್ನಿಪುದ
“ಲೈ ಭರತಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಂ ॥ ಭರತರರಿಭೂಮನೆದಂತಿರಕುಂತಣವೇಳಮಲ್ಲಿನಾಯಕ
"ಮೂಣಿಯುತುರುತರಕೋಣೀಭಾವಿಭುನುಕರಮನೆಬನವಾಸದೇಸವಮೇಳಸಂಪ
'ದೆಗೊಂ ॥ ತದ್ದೆ ಕ್ರಾಧ್ಯನೇಕ್ಷಜಲನಿಧಿವಳಯವಳಯದನಲಧಿಪತಿ ॥ ಯೋನವಸುಧಾ
೧ಗ್ರಾಮಂದುಕುಕಳಂಗಲ್‌ಕಳಗುಡಕಳೆ ಕೂಟು ೯ಕಪದ್ಯಯತಿಯಂಸುದತ್ತೆ ಮುನಿಪ
'ಪ್ಪೊಸರಿಸುಪುದಲಯಾಬಪ್ಪು ವಂಪುಭವಿವಿಸೆನೋಜಿಪೂಜ್ಯು ಲಾರೆಯನುಲವು
'ನಿಪಸ್ಮ್ಯಲಯೊಂಬೆಪೊಯುತ್ತು ತದ್ದೆ ನಿಗೊದಯ್ಯಾನಂಮೋಜಿಮದುಪೊಯುಸ್ವಳನಾಮ
'ಮೂನಾಂತೇನನ್ಯಫ ॥ ಅಂಶುಸದ್ವತಾಚಾರಿಯಸ್ಪದೃದ್ಯಾವಿತ್ರೇಣಿಯವಿನಪವಿತ್ರ
" ವರಿಂತದನ್ಯುಯದೊಳೆನೇಕರವಮೃದಾಥೋೇದಿ ತವಾರ್ಗೋಜ್ಯೊತಿಬಳಿಯ ||
“ಲುವದಯಿಸಿದನವ್ಯತಮದ್ದಿ ೯ಯೋಳಂದಯೋಂಗ್ಯುಮೂರ್ಭಜಾನೊಬಿಸಿ
“ನಗೊಂಕಲ್ಸಪ್ಪದವಿಬೆಲ್ಲ ಅನ್ನಪಂಡ್ಯದುರುಕಳದೆಶೋಲಿಷಕದೇಶೀ ದಾನಾ
೧೪ಭರಣಂ ॥ ಧುತರಂಗೆಂಗಂತ್ಯಂಗಂಪನಿಪತಿಶಕಮಾಳಿತೆ ಕಾಸಾಳಿನಕ್ಕಂ ॥
“ಕರಿಯುಕ್ಕಾ ೯ಳಪುಡವರೂತವ್ಯ್ತಿಯುರುಹಯಶದೊಂದುಧಭಪ್ನಾ

16ಸನಮಾಗತಿ ರವಿದಿವ್ಯಸ್ವಾಪಿಸಿಪಾಳಕನೀರದರುದಂಗರೆಕಾಂತಂಹವಾಂಡಂಬರ
17ಮಂತವಾಳಲ್ವಲ್ಲಿಯಿನೆನಟ್ಟಿವಿಗನೆನಿಸಿದಎಮೀರಲ್ಲಾ ೪ಭೂಪಂ || ಪಗೆನೆರಫಂದಿರ
ಕೆಳಭಾಗ,
18ಕಂಗಿಂದೇಗಡಂಜನಸಂಕಿಶಾಂಬುದಿಂದಪಳಕಮಿಗುವುದುವಿಚಿತ್ರಮಿಂಸದುಗೇದೊಂ
19ಅಬ್ಬಲಲ್ಲಾ ೪ಭೂಪನಜಿನವಿಕದಯಶಂ || ಎನೆನೆನಲ್ಲಾಬಲ್ಲಾ ಅದೇವಂದೋದೇರಸಮುದ್ರ
20ದನಲಿವಿಜಿನೋಳಸಬಿನಸಂಕತಾಪಿನೋದದಿರಾಜ್ಯಂಗೊಯ್ದುತ್ಯಮಿಶ || ದೋರೆದು
21ನೆಕೋಡೇಕಣಿನವನಾಸೂರುಣಹಾಜೀಕಳದಪ್ಪರುಪುಕಾಂತವಿಬುಧೋತ್ಯ ರತ್ನಂಗಳ
22ಕಣಿಯುವನಿಸಿರಂದರಕಣೋಳಗಳಗಳರಾಜಿಸುತಿಕ್ಸಂ || ತದ್ಗನ್ನಧೀಪತಿ ‖ ವನವಾನದೇವೀ
23ಧೂಪಣನೆನಿಸಂಗಾನವಂಡಮಂಡನಂಸಿಕಾ ಒಣತಸ್ಸ ನಮಂಡಳಕಳಕೋಭಿತಫನತರ
24ತಜ್ಜುಜ್ಯ ಕಾಘಪುಸಂಗಾಮಸಾನಂ || ತದಪತ್ನಿ ‖ ದ್ಯುಸನಧಿಕ್ರ್ಯೋತ್ಕುಂಗರಂಗದ್ವ ಹಲ
25ಲಹಾಹಕಂಡೋಳಸೋದದ್ದ್ಯಾ ತಸಫಹಾತನಮೋರ್ಯವ್ಯಲ್ಲತಾಂಚಳಿಳಳವಳಿ
26ತಡಂಬಿರಪುಂಡದಸ್ಯಭೂಮಂಡಲಮಂಡುಮಫಕೇತ್ತ್ರಸನವಿಸಂತೆರ್ವ್ಯೀಳ(ಏನಭ್ವಕ್ಷ)
27ದಿಕ್ಕೃ ತ್ಕನಿಕಾಯುಂತನಿಸಪ್ಪಿದ್ಯೋಸಕದೇವನಸುನೀತಿಗಜಪ್ಪವಂಡಾದೆ ||
28ಮನವಮೊಲ್ಲ್ಯ ಬ್ಯರಕೇಸ್ತ್ರಿಕಣುಮಸಣಾಗ:ವುದೋಕೃತಾಮೃತಿಯಿನದನಸಣವಂ
29ದಿಜನನ್ಯಿ ೯ತಾರ್ಥಕಫಳದಪ್ಪತ್ತ್ಯಕಕಲ್ಪರುನಂದೆನಸದಜ್ಜ್ಯ ಸದದಸ್ಯಬಿಂದನ
30ನಸಬಲಪ್ಪಾಜಾತಪುಣ್ಯವಂಡಮನಕೀರ್ತಿಯಾಸುಯಿಂದುಕುಂದಹ

32ನಮೂತ್ಯಾ೧ಯೊಅಘನತೇಜಸ್ಸುತ್ಯೆ ದ್ಯಾನಿಸಿಪ್ರಭೂಮಂಡನಕೀರ್ತಿ ೪
33ಯುನಸಂಗಭವಮೂತ್ತಿ ೧ಯೊಖೃದೃದಿವಿದಂ || ತದಪತ್ಪರು ‖ ಸೋಮಂ
34ಜನನಯುನೋತ್ಯೃಳನೋರ್ಮುಮನಸೋವಿರೋಧಿಜನಸಿಕ್ಕೃಣಶೀಕ್ರಿಸೀಮಿ

36ಮಿನಿಗಿನಜಿಯಂ || ವಿರತ್ಯೈಪ್ಯೂಜ್ಯನವಾರಥಿನಾಥವಿಭವರಾಜಪ್ರಯಂವಾಹಿ

39ಸ್ತಿಥತ್ತ್ಯಗ್ಗಮನಲತ್ಯ್ಯಾಬ್ಯಕಿ ಯಂಡನಾದೆದಂ || ಸುಮನುಸಭೂಧರರಾಜಿ
40ತಂವಿಪುಳಕಾಬಿಲಂಬುಧರಸ್ಯ ಧಮಮತ್ಯಾಮಜೀತವರಂಸುಪತ್ರ ನಿಜೇಯು
41ಸುಸ್ತೃಂಥೋರಾಕ್ಷಿಸಿರಾಬ್ಯಿಮನುಹೋದಾರೀಲೊಬತನೆಸರದಂಚಿಭ್ಯಕಳ್ಯಪ್ಪಿನ
42ನೀಜೇವೈಸಿನ್ನುವಿಬಧವಸ್ಥು ತಲವಿಭುಮಣಜೇವರಂಕಮುಪೋತ್ಯೆತಸಂ ‖ ಬ
43ದನಲ್ಲ ಒಣಸೇದಮುಬ್ಯಪ್ಯೊಗಲವೊಲೋಕಕ್ಯದ್ದು ಕಣ್ಣಾ ಗೀತಾಸುಜಯಂಗೆ
44ಯುದ್ಧಪಲಿಲಿಂದ್ರಲೇಕಿರಸನಿದ್ಯವೃಕ್ಷ ಕಪಕ್ಕ ಗೆಣದಮವದುಂದೆದಸಗೆತ್ತ್ಯ
45೯ತೀಜ್ಞುನಜಲೆಲ್ಲೊಲುಣ್ಜೇರಸಂತಾನನಲತ್ತು ದ್ಯುಯೊದ್ಯುನಿಳಶಾಳಸುತ್ತಮಹಾ

48ಮಹಾದೇವಣದನಸಫಹೂರ್ತೃವನಸೊಲ್‌ || ಅಂಟುಃತೀ ಗಣಪುಡಂತನಂ
49ಯುಮಹಾಹವೇದದನಸಥನಂತದಪತ್ಯುರೊಂಟೆರನು || ಸಲ್ಲಿತಗುಣ
50ಗಣಾಸಿ ಕೆವಳ್ಳಭನಥವಾಮನುತ್ಯ್ಯ ? ‖ ಶ್ರೀ ವಧುಧರ್ಮಚೆಳ್ಳವಿರಾಜೇವಮಲ್ಲಿ

ಸೊರಬ ತಾಲೂಕು.
51ಫಲಂಶ್ರೀಸ್ವೈಪ್ಸುತಾಮನಂಮದನಮಲ್ಲಂ || ಎನೆನೆಗೆಲ್‌ ಮಲ್ಲ ಸಿಟ್‌ಗಮನವಸಮ
52ಚಾರಿತ್ರ್ಯನೀತೇವನಾಚಾರಂಬೀಕ್‌ಗಂಜಿವಸಿದಂಸುಕೃತಸಂಜಾನಿನೀಯೆ
53ನೀಜಕುಲಕೇಸೀವಮನಳಿಲಾಲಮಂ || ನೆಗಲ್ದ್‌ಗ್ಗುಗರುಗಳು ಇಂಚ್‌ಂದ್ರಗಣಿವರವರ್ಯ್ಯ್ಕ್‌
54ಲಸಂಗಕಾನ್ಮಗಣಾಡೋರ್ಲ್ಯ್ಗಣಿಯಸುನುಸನ್ನ ವಶದೊಳ್‌ನೀತಿವರವರ್ಗ್ಗೆ
55ನೈಮುವನ್‌ವಿಜನ್‌ರಾಮನ್‌ || ಹರಿಹತಮೂತ್ರಿ ತಾಭ್ಯುಜನ್‌ಕಾಲ್‌ ಕುವಂಜಭೂಷಣೇ
56ಮನೆಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯತ ರದೊಳ್‌ಕೂಡೆಜಯ್ಯಬಿಗನದೆಡೇನದೆನಿಸಿಪ್ಪನಾಳ್‌ ಳಾತ್ಪರವಮು
57ಜಿನೇಂದ್ರಗೇಹಮವನೇಕ್‌ಕಮವನದ್ದುರಿಸುತ್ತ ಮಿತ್ರ ಲುದ್ದ ರಿದಿನಸುತ್ತ ಲೊತ್ತರ
58ಮೆನೆಲನುಜಾಕ್ತಿ ತಫಲತಾಪಿತಾನಮಂ || ಕೊಡಕಣিপুরಲಕ್ಮೀ ಯಮಯೊಪ್ಪ ದಾವನೀ
59ಸಿರನೆನ್ವಿಮತ್ರ್ಯವಿಭುವನಾದಿಸಿವಂಡಕೂರ್ಗ್ಯ್ಕಕೀರ್ತಿ ಲ್ಲತಾಗುಡಿಇಖುವಿನಿಸಾ
60ನ್ನಿ ನಾಭನಿನಮಂದಿರಮನ್‌ || ಮನಮಹಾತ್ಮ್ಮ ತ್ರಿಪ್ರಿತಿಜಿನತಿಂತಸುಬೃತಿನದಂಜೀ
61ನೆಂದ್ಯ್ಚಲಯಸಂಜನನಕ್‌ಯೋಮಂದಿಶಿಪವನವಮಗೀರನೇಮಿಸೆಟ್ಟಿನಗಲ್‌ಗಜ
62ಗದುಳ || ಅನ್ನು ನೇಮಿಪುಟ್ಟಿಸಕ[ಪ್ದಪದಾನಜಾಮೂವತನೆಮವಿಭವಸನವ
63ತ್ತರಡಜೆಪ್ಪುಕ ಗಂ ಕುಕ್ತವಾರದೋಳಣಿನ್ನಿ ನಾಫದೇವಪ್ರಸತಿಂತ್ಯು ದಂವಾಲ್ವಾ
64ಕಾಡೂಳೊಳ್ತಿ ಗಣಾಪುಣ್ಣ್ಯ ನುಂತಥ ನೂಜರುಅಂತನುಯಮಹದೇವೀ
65ವದಣ್ಣ ಸಾಯು ಸುಸಂಪಿತವಮಾರಿಲಂದೇವವರಪ್ಪವಿಧಾಳಕ್ಷ್ನೆಸೆಗೆಲಿಸಿ
66ಯದಾರಹೇದಾನಕಂಕೊಟ್ಟಗಗ್ಗ ಕಮ್ಮು ೨೦ ವರದ್ವೇಶ್ರೀಕಂರಬ್ರ್ಬ
67ಕಿಪರಿಕೀದೇವತ್ಸಾನ್ನಿಗಹೀತಾತ್ಮ್ಯಗೌಗನಿರ್ಮಿತಯೇಂಗಪ್ಪಿಟ್ಯೊಯುನಾವ
68ರಿದಿಂದೆವಪೂಜಂಸಂಜುಮಸೀಕ್ಯ್ಕವಫ್ರೊಲ || ಯಿದುಮತೋಗಣಪಟ್ಚಿಯೊ
69ನಾನ್ಸು ದುಮದ್ದ ಮೃ ದಲಂದೆಂದವಸಬೈತಗಣಾತ್ತ್ಯದಿತುಯಹಪ್ಪೃತಿ
70ಪೂಳಿಪರುದಾತ್ತ ವೀಲಾಸ್ತಿ ನಾಫಜಿನಮಂದಿರಮಂ ||

text.location: In Soraba, on a pillar of the avabhṛita-maṇṭapa on the eastern bank of the Daṇḍāvati river.
text.remarks:
Having the supreme profound *syâd-vâda* as a fruit-bearing token, may it prevail, the doctrine
of the lord of the three worlds, the Jina-śâsana.

In the lotus pond the ocean, like a stalk for the lotus Jambu-dvipa was the golden mountain ;
south from which, with ruddy hue, shone the Bharata-kshêtra; an ornament to Bharata was the
Kuntaṇa-dêśa; as the chief jewel in which, of distracting brilliance, was the Banavâsa-dêśa.

The master of that country and of many other countries surrounded by the ocean :-When,
desiring to give this chief place in the world to Saḷa of the Yadu-kula, Sudatta-munipa made
Padmâvati appar, -on her coming as a tiger, seeing and recognizing her, he said *poy Sala* (strike,
Sala), whereupon he smote it with the munipa's rod *(sele)*, and displaying his courage to the
goddess, that king acquired the name Poysaḷa.

After Sudattâchâriya had thus obtained from the goddess Padmâvati and bestowed it, in many
that line ruled the kingdom in succession. After whom was born the king Ballâḷa; praise of his
fame, the streams of whose brilliance washed the collyrium from the eyes of his enemies' wives.

When Ballâḷa-Dêva was in the residence of Dôrasamudra, ruling the kingdom in peace and
wisdom :-

Sorab Taluq.

Koḍakaṇi was distinguished as a mine (*kaṇi*) of the gems of learned men and beautiful women
in the Rōhaṇa mountain Banavāse. Its ruler, an ornament to the Banavāsa-dēśa, a gāvuṇḍa glory,
his pure fame like saffron to the breasts of the ladies the points of the compass,—was Masana.
His son, (with praises) was Kirtyi-gāvuṇḍa. His sons were Sōma, Masana, Mahādēva and Rāma.
His son-in-law was Mahādēva-daṇḍanātha ; (his praises).

To Malla-Seṭṭi and Māchāmbike was born Nēma, whose guru was Gunachandra of the Mūla-
saṅgha and Kānūr-gaṇa. Nēmi-Seṭṭi, of the Nunna-vaṁśa, raised up many Jinēndra temples
in Jidvalige-nāḍ and Eḍe-nāḍ. And in Koḍakaṇi he caused to be made the S’āntinātha Jinālaya.

Thus Nēmi-Seṭṭi (on the date specified^{1}) at the time of setting up the god S’āntinātha,
surrounded by Kirtyi-gāvuṇḍa, with his sons and his son-in-law Mahādēva-daṇḍanātha, made a
grant of 50 poles of rice-land for the eight kinds of ceremonies of the god, and for the food of
the rishis.

And S’rīkaṇṭha-bratipa gave to the priest of the S’ānti-Jina temple a suitable abode, which
was like a cage of adamant.

text.text_original: ಸೊರಬದಲ್ಲಿ ದಂಡಾಪತೀ ನದಿಯ ಪೂರ್ವದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಹ್ಯತಮಂಟುಪದ ಕಂಠೆದಲ್ಲಿ. “ಶ್ರೀ ಶ್ರುಮದ್ರವಮಂಗಭರಸಸ್ಯದೃಧಾವುನರಫೇಲಾಂಭನಂಜಯಾತ್ರೆ) ಳಲೋಕ್ಯ 'ನಾಫನ್ಮ್ಯಕ್ಷಾಸನಂಜಿಜಿನಾಸನಂ ॥ ಅಂಬುಧಿ ಕಮಲಕಕರೆದೊಳ್  ಒಂಬ್ವೀಲ್ಪಾ 'ಪ್ಪ ದೋಂದುಕಕಣ್ಣಿ ೯ ಕೆಯಿನಿಕುಂಫ್ಣಜಟ್ಟದಟೀಲಿತೆಂತಕುಟೊಜತ್ತೆ  ಸರ್ನಿಪುದ “ಲೈ ಭರತಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಂ ॥ ಭರತರರಿಭೂಮನೆದಂತಿರಕುಂತಣವೇಳಮಲ್ಲಿನಾಯಕ "ಮೂಣಿಯುತುರುತರಕೋಣೀಭಾವಿಭುನುಕರಮನೆಬನವಾಸದೇಸವಮೇಳಸಂಪ 'ದೆಗೊಂ ॥ ತದ್ದೆ ಕ್ರಾಧ್ಯನೇಕ್ಷಜಲನಿಧಿವಳಯವಳಯದನಲಧಿಪತಿ ॥ ಯೋನವಸುಧಾ ೧ಗ್ರಾಮಂದುಕುಕಳಂಗಲ್‌ಕಳಗುಡಕಳೆ  ಕೂಟು ೯ಕಪದ್ಯಯತಿಯಂಸುದತ್ತೆ ಮುನಿಪ 'ಪ್ಪೊಸರಿಸುಪುದಲಯಾಬಪ್ಪು ವಂಪುಭವಿವಿಸೆನೋಜಿಪೂಜ್ಯು  ಲಾರೆಯನುಲವು 'ನಿಪಸ್ಮ್ಯಲಯೊಂಬೆಪೊಯುತ್ತು ತದ್ದೆ ನಿಗೊದಯ್ಯಾನಂಮೋಜಿಮದುಪೊಯುಸ್ವಳನಾಮ 'ಮೂನಾಂತೇನನ್ಯಫ ॥ ಅಂಶುಸದ್ವತಾಚಾರಿಯಸ್ಪದೃದ್ಯಾವಿತ್ರೇಣಿಯವಿನಪವಿತ್ರ " ವರಿಂತದನ್ಯುಯದೊಳೆನೇಕರವಮೃದಾಥೋೇದಿ ತವಾರ್ಗೋಜ್ಯೊತಿಬಳಿಯ || “ಲುವದಯಿಸಿದನವ್ಯತಮದ್ದಿ  ೯ಯೋಳಂದಯೋಂಗ್ಯುಮೂರ್ಭಜಾನೊಬಿಸಿ “ನಗೊಂಕಲ್ಸಪ್ಪದವಿಬೆಲ್ಲ  ಅನ್ನಪಂಡ್ಯದುರುಕಳದೆಶೋಲಿಷಕದೇಶೀ  ದಾನಾ ೧೪ಭರಣಂ ॥ ಧುತರಂಗೆಂಗಂತ್ಯಂಗಂಪನಿಪತಿಶಕಮಾಳಿತೆ ಕಾಸಾಳಿನಕ್ಕಂ ॥ “ಕರಿಯುಕ್ಕಾ  ೯ಳಪುಡವರೂತವ್ಯ್ತಿಯುರುಹಯಶದೊಂದುಧಭಪ್ನಾ16ಸನಮಾಗತಿ ರವಿದಿವ್ಯಸ್ವಾಪಿಸಿಪಾಳಕನೀರದರುದಂಗರೆಕಾಂತಂಹವಾಂಡಂಬರ17ಮಂತವಾಳಲ್ವಲ್ಲಿಯಿನೆನಟ್ಟಿವಿಗನೆನಿಸಿದಎಮೀರಲ್ಲಾ ೪ಭೂಪಂ || ಪಗೆನೆರಫಂದಿರಕೆಳಭಾಗ,18ಕಂಗಿಂದೇಗಡಂಜನಸಂಕಿಶಾಂಬುದಿಂದಪಳಕಮಿಗುವುದುವಿಚಿತ್ರಮಿಂಸದುಗೇದೊಂ19ಅಬ್ಬಲಲ್ಲಾ ೪ಭೂಪನಜಿನವಿಕದಯಶಂ || ಎನೆನೆನಲ್ಲಾಬಲ್ಲಾ ಅದೇವಂದೋದೇರಸಮುದ್ರ20ದನಲಿವಿಜಿನೋಳಸಬಿನಸಂಕತಾಪಿನೋದದಿರಾಜ್ಯಂಗೊಯ್ದುತ್ಯಮಿಶ || ದೋರೆದು21ನೆಕೋಡೇಕಣಿನವನಾಸೂರುಣಹಾಜೀಕಳದಪ್ಪರುಪುಕಾಂತವಿಬುಧೋತ್ಯ ರತ್ನಂಗಳ22ಕಣಿಯುವನಿಸಿರಂದರಕಣೋಳಗಳಗಳರಾಜಿಸುತಿಕ್ಸಂ || ತದ್ಗನ್ನಧೀಪತಿ ‖ ವನವಾನದೇವೀ23ಧೂಪಣನೆನಿಸಂಗಾನವಂಡಮಂಡನಂಸಿಕಾ ಒಣತಸ್ಸ ನಮಂಡಳಕಳಕೋಭಿತಫನತರ24ತಜ್ಜುಜ್ಯ ಕಾಘಪುಸಂಗಾಮಸಾನಂ || ತದಪತ್ನಿ ‖ ದ್ಯುಸನಧಿಕ್ರ್ಯೋತ್ಕುಂಗರಂಗದ್ವ ಹಲ25ಲಹಾಹಕಂಡೋಳಸೋದದ್ದ್ಯಾ ತಸಫಹಾತನಮೋರ್ಯವ್ಯಲ್ಲತಾಂಚಳಿಳಳವಳಿ26ತಡಂಬಿರಪುಂಡದಸ್ಯಭೂಮಂಡಲಮಂಡುಮಫಕೇತ್ತ್ರಸನವಿಸಂತೆರ್ವ್ಯೀಳ(ಏನಭ್ವಕ್ಷ)27ದಿಕ್ಕೃ ತ್ಕನಿಕಾಯುಂತನಿಸಪ್ಪಿದ್ಯೋಸಕದೇವನಸುನೀತಿಗಜಪ್ಪವಂಡಾದೆ ||28ಮನವಮೊಲ್ಲ್ಯ ಬ್ಯರಕೇಸ್ತ್ರಿಕಣುಮಸಣಾಗ:ವುದೋಕೃತಾಮೃತಿಯಿನದನಸಣವಂ29ದಿಜನನ್ಯಿ ೯ತಾರ್ಥಕಫಳದಪ್ಪತ್ತ್ಯಕಕಲ್ಪರುನಂದೆನಸದಜ್ಜ್ಯ ಸದದಸ್ಯಬಿಂದನ30ನಸಬಲಪ್ಪಾಜಾತಪುಣ್ಯವಂಡಮನಕೀರ್ತಿಯಾಸುಯಿಂದುಕುಂದಹ31ರಹಾಹನಸೀದ್ದ್ಯ ಸಿಸಕ್ತಿ ಕೃತಿಯಂ || ಆತ್ಮಿಳವದಾನಿಯೊಧರಕೀರ್ತಿ ಶಕುಮಭಿಮಾ32ನಮೂತ್ಯಾ೧ಯೊಅಘನತೇಜಸ್ಸುತ್ಯೆ ದ್ಯಾನಿಸಿಪ್ರಭೂಮಂಡನಕೀರ್ತಿ ೪33ಯುನಸಂಗಭವಮೂತ್ತಿ ೧ಯೊಖೃದೃದಿವಿದಂ || ತದಪತ್ಪರು ‖ ಸೋಮಂ34ಜನನಯುನೋತ್ಯೃಳನೋರ್ಮುಮನಸೋವಿರೋಧಿಜನಸಿಕ್ಕೃಣಶೀಕ್ರಿಸೀಮಿ35ತಮಹಹವೇಂವಪೇಮುಮಾಹೇವನಾಲೈ ರಾಮರಣಾಸಂ ‖ ಆಕ್ರೀಗಾವಣ್ಣನ36ಮಿನಿಗಿನಜಿಯಂ || ವಿರತ್ಯೈಪ್ಯೂಜ್ಯನವಾರಥಿನಾಥವಿಭವರಾಜಪ್ರಯಂವಾಹಿ37ನಿಪತಿಭೂೋಗೀಳ್ಯರಭೂಷಣಂಚುತುಷ್ಯಂಕಾಂಕೇಕವಪ್ಪೇಳನಿವಕೃತನಯೋಲ್ಪ38ನಸುವಿರಾಜಿಸಿನವಹಾಮಹಜೇದವನೆತರದೀಯಂಕಣ್ಯನನ39ಸ್ತಿಥತ್ತ್ಯಗ್ಗಮನಲತ್ಯ್ಯಾಬ್ಯಕಿ ಯಂಡನಾದೆದಂ || ಸುಮನುಸಭೂಧರರಾಜಿ40ತಂವಿಪುಳಕಾಬಿಲಂಬುಧರಸ್ಯ ಧಮಮತ್ಯಾಮಜೀತವರಂಸುಪತ್ರ ನಿಜೇಯು41ಸುಸ್ತೃಂಥೋರಾಕ್ಷಿಸಿರಾಬ್ಯಿಮನುಹೋದಾರೀಲೊಬತನೆಸರದಂಚಿಭ್ಯಕಳ್ಯಪ್ಪಿನ42ನೀಜೇವೈಸಿನ್ನುವಿಬಧವಸ್ಥು ತಲವಿಭುಮಣಜೇವರಂಕಮುಪೋತ್ಯೆತಸಂ ‖ ಬ43ದನಲ್ಲ ಒಣಸೇದಮುಬ್ಯಪ್ಯೊಗಲವೊಲೋಕಕ್ಯದ್ದು ಕಣ್ಣಾ ಗೀತಾಸುಜಯಂಗೆ44ಯುದ್ಧಪಲಿಲಿಂದ್ರಲೇಕಿರಸನಿದ್ಯವೃಕ್ಷ ಕಪಕ್ಕ ಗೆಣದಮವದುಂದೆದಸಗೆತ್ತ್ಯ45೯ತೀಜ್ಞುನಜಲೆಲ್ಲೊಲುಣ್ಜೇರಸಂತಾನನಲತ್ತು ದ್ಯುಯೊದ್ಯುನಿಳಶಾಳಸುತ್ತಮಹಾ46ದೇವಣಜವಮೂಪೋತ್ರತಂ || ಕವಿರಿಪುಗುರುಗೂರುಜಿತಪುಗುವದವರೆವ47ರನ್ನ್ಯರಿತ್ರಿಕವಿಗಿನುಜಾತತ್ಯೇವ ವಮನೌದವಮಂತ್ರ ಗುಣಚೆಷ್ಯು ವೆದು48ಮಹಾದೇವಣದನಸಫಹೂರ್ತೃವನಸೊಲ್‌ || ಅಂಟುಃತೀ ಗಣಪುಡಂತನಂ49ಯುಮಹಾಹವೇದದನಸಥನಂತದಪತ್ಯುರೊಂಟೆರನು || ಸಲ್ಲಿತಗುಣ50ಗಣಾಸಿ ಕೆವಳ್ಳಭನಥವಾಮನುತ್ಯ್ಯ ? ‖ ಶ್ರೀ ವಧುಧರ್ಮಚೆಳ್ಳವಿರಾಜೇವಮಲ್ಲಿಸೊರಬ ತಾಲೂಕು.51ಫಲಂಶ್ರೀಸ್ವೈಪ್ಸುತಾಮನಂಮದನಮಲ್ಲಂ || ಎನೆನೆಗೆಲ್‌ ಮಲ್ಲ ಸಿಟ್‌ಗಮನವಸಮ52ಚಾರಿತ್ರ್ಯನೀತೇವನಾಚಾರಂಬೀಕ್‌ಗಂಜಿವಸಿದಂಸುಕೃತಸಂಜಾನಿನೀಯೆ53ನೀಜಕುಲಕೇಸೀವಮನಳಿಲಾಲಮಂ || ನೆಗಲ್ದ್‌ಗ್ಗುಗರುಗಳು ಇಂಚ್‌ಂದ್ರಗಣಿವರವರ್ಯ್ಯ್ಕ್‌54ಲಸಂಗಕಾನ್ಮಗಣಾಡೋರ್ಲ್ಯ್ಗಣಿಯಸುನುಸನ್ನ ವಶದೊಳ್‌ನೀತಿವರವರ್ಗ್ಗೆ55ನೈಮುವನ್‌ವಿಜನ್‌ರಾಮನ್‌ || ಹರಿಹತಮೂತ್ರಿ ತಾಭ್ಯುಜನ್‌ಕಾಲ್‌ ಕುವಂಜಭೂಷಣೇ56ಮನೆಸೆಟ್ಟಿಯತ ರದೊಳ್‌ಕೂಡೆಜಯ್ಯಬಿಗನದೆಡೇನದೆನಿಸಿಪ್ಪನಾಳ್‌ ಳಾತ್ಪರವಮು57ಜಿನೇಂದ್ರಗೇಹಮವನೇಕ್‌ಕಮವನದ್ದುರಿಸುತ್ತ ಮಿತ್ರ ಲುದ್ದ ರಿದಿನಸುತ್ತ ಲೊತ್ತರ58ಮೆನೆಲನುಜಾಕ್ತಿ ತಫಲತಾಪಿತಾನಮಂ || ಕೊಡಕಣিপুরಲಕ್ಮೀ ಯಮಯೊಪ್ಪ ದಾವನೀ59ಸಿರನೆನ್ವಿಮತ್ರ್ಯವಿಭುವನಾದಿಸಿವಂಡಕೂರ್ಗ್ಯ್ಕಕೀರ್ತಿ ಲ್ಲತಾಗುಡಿಇಖುವಿನಿಸಾ60ನ್ನಿ ನಾಭನಿನಮಂದಿರಮನ್‌ || ಮನಮಹಾತ್ಮ್ಮ ತ್ರಿಪ್ರಿತಿಜಿನತಿಂತಸುಬೃತಿನದಂಜೀ61ನೆಂದ್ಯ್ಚಲಯಸಂಜನನಕ್‌ಯೋಮಂದಿಶಿಪವನವಮಗೀರನೇಮಿಸೆಟ್ಟಿನಗಲ್‌ಗಜ62ಗದುಳ || ಅನ್ನು ನೇಮಿಪುಟ್ಟಿಸಕ[ಪ್ದಪದಾನಜಾಮೂವತನೆಮವಿಭವಸನವ63ತ್ತರಡಜೆಪ್ಪುಕ ಗಂ ಕುಕ್ತವಾರದೋಳಣಿನ್ನಿ ನಾಫದೇವಪ್ರಸತಿಂತ್ಯು ದಂವಾಲ್ವಾ64ಕಾಡೂಳೊಳ್ತಿ ಗಣಾಪುಣ್ಣ್ಯ ನುಂತಥ ನೂಜರುಅಂತನುಯಮಹದೇವೀ65ವದಣ್ಣ ಸಾಯು ಸುಸಂಪಿತವಮಾರಿಲಂದೇವವರಪ್ಪವಿಧಾಳಕ್ಷ್ನೆಸೆಗೆಲಿಸಿ66ಯದಾರಹೇದಾನಕಂಕೊಟ್ಟಗಗ್ಗ ಕಮ್ಮು ೨೦ ವರದ್ವೇಶ್ರೀಕಂರಬ್ರ್ಬ67ಕಿಪರಿಕೀದೇವತ್ಸಾನ್ನಿಗಹೀತಾತ್ಮ್ಯಗೌಗನಿರ್ಮಿತಯೇಂಗಪ್ಪಿಟ್ಯೊಯುನಾವ68ರಿದಿಂದೆವಪೂಜಂಸಂಜುಮಸೀಕ್ಯ್ಕವಫ್ರೊಲ || ಯಿದುಮತೋಗಣಪಟ್ಚಿಯೊ69ನಾನ್ಸು ದುಮದ್ದ ಮೃ ದಲಂದೆಂದವಸಬೈತಗಣಾತ್ತ್ಯದಿತುಯಹಪ್ಪೃತಿ70ಪೂಳಿಪರುದಾತ್ತ ವೀಲಾಸ್ತಿ ನಾಫಜಿನಮಂದಿರಮಂ ||

cells.language: Sanskrit and Kannada
cells.remarks: S'rî-Mrigēsvaravarvammaṇa (on the seal). Be it well. In Vijaya-Vaijayanti,2,—of the Kadambas, purified by meditation on Svâmi-Mahâ- sēna and the group of Mothers,3 of the Mânavya-gôtra, Hâriti-putras, versed in the views they have formed on the sacred writings,4 protected by Ambâ,—śrimat Kâkustha's dear son's son, śri-Mrigē- svaravarvammâ,—in this manner, in his eighth victorious year, on the full moon day of Vaiśâkha, with water and a gift,—to the pious Sômaśarmmâryya, born in a family well acquainted with the śâstras, [donors of] a crore of virgins, of the Gautama-gôtra,—gave the Kaḍaḷakaḷani village, with the Vâstuka-kshētra (its boundaries),—requisite notice having been given to the occupants of the coun- try and the several villages,—freed from all imposts, and not to be entered by troops. Usual benedictions and imprecations.
